title: Israeli air strike on a vehicle in Gaza kills two Hamas security officials
english: An Israeli airstrike in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, resulted in the deaths of two Hamas security officials, including a senior internal security leader. This attack follows a similar strike that killed the head of the Hamas police force in northern Gaza just one day prior. Hamas claims these targeted killings are an attempt by Israel to destabilize the region's governance, while recent ceasefire efforts remain largely ineffective.

oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el magaalaa Deeyr al-Balaah keessatti haleellaa geggeesseen hoogganaa nageenyaa keessoo Hamas dabalatee namoonni nageenyaa lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko dura ajajaan poolisii Hamas kan kaaba Gaazaa haleellaa walfakkaatuun ajjeefamuu isaa booda. Hamas tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Israa'el bulchiinsa Gaazaa diiguuf kan qopheesse ta'uu ibsee, yaaliiwwan waraana dhaabsiisuuf godhaman hanga ammaatti bu'aa hin argatin jiru.

title: Yemen’s health workers race to halt latest outbreak of deadly dengue fever
english: Health workers in the Yemeni city of Mukalla are working hard to control a new outbreak of dengue fever. They are identifying and clearing stagnant water sources where mosquitoes, which carry the deadly virus, frequently breed. Despite previous prevention efforts, the team faces ongoing challenges as they continue to find active breeding sites in densely populated neighborhoods.

oromo: Hojjettoonni fayyaa magaalaa Yemen, Mukalla keessatti dhukkuba dhibee Dengue jedhamu kan lubbuu galaafatu kana ittisuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Gareen kun dhukkubichaa kan fidu ilbiisa (cininsaa) iddoo bishaan ciisee itti wal-horu qorachuun balleessaa jiru. Hojii ittisaa kanaan dura hojjetamee tureyyuu, naannolee baay'inni uummataa keessatti ol-aanaa ta'e keessatti iddoon ilbiisonni kun itti wal-horan ammas waan argamaa jiruuf hojiin kun rakkoo cimaa ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: From paradise to ‘pilot zone’ disaster: Returning to destroyed Lebanon home
english: Sumaya Yaghi recently returned to her village in southern Lebanon to find her home completely destroyed following an Israeli military withdrawal. Her village had been designated as a so-called pilot zone under a US-brokered agreement. She is now grappling with the aftermath of the conflict as she assesses the damage to her property.

Gandi ishee kun bakka itti waraanni Israa'el qormaata gaggeessu ta'ee kan ture dha. Amma isheen miidhaa qabeenya ishee irra ga'e kana keessatti gadda cimaa keessa jirti.

title: Why are Israeli settlers on a rampage in the occupied West Bank?
english: Tensions in the occupied West Bank have escalated significantly following a violent confrontation between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in the town of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead. In the aftermath, Israeli settlers have carried out retaliatory attacks, including torching mosques and detaining local residents. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pledged to expand military operations in the area, leading to increased security deployments and further instability for the Palestinian population.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት በታል ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰ ግጭት አራት ፍልስጤማውያን እና ሁለት እስራኤላውያን ከተገደሉ በኋላ ውጥረቱ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አድጓል። ይህንን ተከትሎ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች መስጊዶችን በማቃጠል እና የፍልስጤም ነዋሪዎችን በማሰር የበቀል ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በግዛቱ ወታደራዊ እርምጃቸውን እንደሚያሰፉ በመግለጻቸው፣ በክልሉ ተጨማሪ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ተሰማርተው የፍልስጤም ነዋሪዎች ላይ ያለው ሥጋት ተባብሷል።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee West Bank jedhamutti erga namootni afur fi Israa'elootni lama walitti bu'iinsa magaala Tal keessatti mudateen du'anii booda, walitti bu'iinsi sun daran hammaateera. Haaluma kanaan, qubattootni Israa'el masjiidota gubuu fi namoota naannichaa hidhuun haaloo bahaa jiru. Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuun tarkaanfii waraanaa naannichatti babal'isuuf waadaa waan seenaniif, loltoonni dabalataa ergamee jiraachuun isaatiin ummanni Falasxiin sodaachisaa keessa galanii jiru.

title: Langton released from hospital after concussion at Commonwealth Games
english: British gymnast Gabriel Langton has been discharged from the hospital following a serious fall during the Commonwealth Games. The 19-year-old athlete suffered a concussion after landing on his head during a high bar routine but is now recovering well. Despite the accident, his teammates successfully secured a silver medal, which Langton hopes to celebrate with them soon.

title: What next for the ICC and the Palestine investigation after Karim Khan's removal?
english: The International Criminal Court has voted to remove Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan following allegations of misconduct, marking the first such dismissal in the institution's history. This decision has sparked significant uncertainty regarding the status of the ongoing investigation into Palestine and the previously issued arrest warrants for Israeli officials. While supporters of the move celebrate his departure, critics argue the disciplinary process was politically motivated. The court now faces the challenge of selecting a successor and determining how this leadership change will affect its legal proceedings.

Murtii seenaa qabeessa ta'e kanaan, qorannoon Falasxiin irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru fi ajajni qabamuu kan mootota Israa'el irratti darbe haala gaaffii keessa galcheera. Warri murtichaa morman adeemsi kun siyaasa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsanii jiru, Israa'el garuu tarkaanfichi kan irra ture dha jettee simatteetti. Amma mana murtichatti namni bakka isaa bu'u filachuun fi gara fuulduraatti qorannoo kana akkamitti akka itti fufan murtii irra gahuun isaanii kan eegamuudha.

title: US envoy to UN: Trump pausing strikes to 'give a little bit of room' for Iran talks
english: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz stated that President Trump has temporarily stopped military strikes against Iran to allow space for diplomatic discussions. This pause follows two weeks of continuous conflict, though no specific details regarding the status of these talks were shared. The decision comes after Iran also recently declared an end to its own attacks on neighboring Gulf nations.

title: Iran's Pezeshkian orders immediate reconstruction of infrastructure damaged in US attacks
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has directed authorities to quickly repair key infrastructure that was harmed during recent US military strikes. He highlighted that restoring these facilities, particularly rail links with neighboring countries, is crucial for strengthening the nation's economy. The president believes these improvements will better integrate Iran into regional transit networks and enhance its geopolitical position.

Hojiiwwan kunneen, keessattuu hidhannoowwan daandii baaburaa biyyoota ollaa wajjin wal qabsiisan, dinagdee biyyattii cimsuuf barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsameera. Pirezidaantichi fooyya'iinsi bu'uuraalee misoomaa kunneen, Iraan guddina dinagdee fi hariiroo naannawaa keessatti gahee qabdu akka cimsitu amanu.

title: Oil tanker explodes after hitting naval mine in Hormuz, Iranian media reports
english: An oil tanker was destroyed in the Strait of Hormuz following an explosion caused by a naval mine. According to reports from Iranian media, the ship hit the explosive device shortly after leaving a designated safe path. No further details about potential casualties or the origin of the mine have been provided.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ የነዳጅ ጭነት የጫነ መርከብ በባህር ፈንጂ በመመታቱ ፍንዳታ ደርሶበታል። የኢራን መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት፣ መርከቧ አደጋው የደረሰባት መንግስት ከተፈቀደላት የጉዞ መስመር ውጪ በወጣችበት ወቅት ነው። ስለጉዳቱ ወይም ስለ ፈንጂው ምንጭ ተጨማሪ መረጃ እስካሁን አልተገለጸም።

Oduun miidiyaalee Iraan akka ibsutti, dooniin tun karaa hayyamameef keessaa erga baatee booda boombii sanaan rukutamte. Haata'u malee, waa'ee namoota miidhamanii fi madda bombichaa hanga ammaatti ifatti hin himamne.

title: Waves of settler attacks target mosques, homes and businesses across West Bank
english: Israeli settlers conducted widespread attacks across several West Bank regions, including burning mosques in Nablus and Tulkarm. The assaults involved property destruction, vehicle damage, and the use of live ammunition against local residents. Reports indicate these actions were carried out in multiple districts while allegedly under the protection of Israeli security forces.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚገኙ በርካታ አካባቢዎች ላይ ሰፊ ጥቃት የፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ በናብሉስ እና በቱልካረም የሚገኙ መስጂዶችን በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። ጥቃቱ የንብረት ውድመት፣ የተሽከርካሪዎች መጎዳት እና በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥይቶችን መተኮስን ያካትታል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጥበቃ ስር የተፈጸሙ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda garaa garaa kan Lixaa Baankii keessatti haleellaa bal'aa raawwataniiru; kana keessattis masjiidonni Nablusii fi Tulkaaram keessatti argaman gubamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan qabeenyi namootaa fi konkolaattonni barbadaa'uu irra darbee, namoota irratti dhukaasni banameera. Gochootni kunneen hundi poolisoota Israa'el biraa eegumsa argachaa akka raawwataman gabaafameera.

title: Iran’s army issues warning ahead of Netanyahu’s US visit
english: The Iranian military has declared a temporary pause in their retaliatory strikes within the Gulf region. However, they have issued a stern warning to the United States ahead of Benjamin Netanyahu's upcoming trip to Washington. Tehran cautioned that any further American military actions would lead to a significant escalation and expansion of the conflict throughout the Middle East.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይል በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ የነበረውን የአጸፋ እርምጃ በጊዜያዊነት እንዳቆመ አስታውቋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ወደ ዋሽንግተን ከማቅናታቸው አስቀድሞ፣ ኢራን ለአሜሪካ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥታለች። አሜሪካ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶችን የምትፈጽም ከሆነ ግጭቱ ተባብሶ በመላው የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አካባቢ እንደሚስፋፋ ተሄራን አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Iraan naannoo Gulf keessatti tarkaanfii deebii kennuu yeroof dhaabuu isaa beeksiseera. Haa ta’u malee, ministirri muummee Israa’el Benyamin Netanyaahu gara Waashingitan utuu hin imalin dura, Iraan akeekkachiisa cimaa Ameerikaaf laatteetti. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa dabalataa kan fudhattu yoo ta’e, waraanichi daran hammaatee guutuu naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessatti akka babal’atu Tehraan akeekkachiisteetti.

title: ‘No accountability for settler war crimes against Palestinians’
english: Israeli authorities have increased their crackdown on Palestinians in the West Bank following a violent settler attack that left six people dead. Activist Phyllis Bennis highlights that these actions constitute serious war crimes that continue to occur without any legal consequences. There is growing concern that the lack of accountability for such violence is fueling further instability in the region.
amharic: ስድስት ሰዎችን የገደለ የአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ተከትሎ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ አጠናክረዋል። አክቲቪስት ፊሊስ ቤኒስ እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ምንም አይነት ህጋዊ ተጠያቂነት የሌለባቸው የጦር ወንጀሎች ናቸው። ለእንደዚህ አይነት ጥቃቶች ተጠያቂነት አለመኖር በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት እያባባሰው እንደሆነ ስጋት አለ።
oromo: Humni Israa'el miidhaa fi gidiraa ishee kanneen naannoo West Bank jiraatan irratti dabaltuudha; kunis erga haleellaa garee iddoo buufatanii jiraatan (settlers) namoota ja'a ajjeese booda kan dhufe dha. Akka ogeettii mirga namoomaa Phillis Bennis jedhanitti, haleellaan kun yakka waraanaa guddaa kan of keessatti qabatuu fi kanneen raawwatan irratti hamma ammaatti himanni tokko illee hin banamne. Namootni yakka kana raawwatan bilisa ta'uun isaanii naannicha keessatti jeequmsi akka itti fufu taasiseera.

title: Malaysia to host rescheduled Bahrain Grand Prix F1 race in October
english: Formula One has announced that the Bahrain Grand Prix, originally canceled due to regional instability, will be held at the Sepang circuit in Malaysia this October. The race, officially branded as the Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, will take place on October 4. This event brings the season back to 23 races as organizers navigate ongoing security concerns in the Middle East.
amharic: የፎርሙላ ዋን ውድድር አዘጋጆች ቀደም ሲል በክልሉ በተፈጠረው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ተሰርዞ የነበረው የባህሬን ግራንድ ፕሪክስ ውድድር በጥቅምት ወር በባህሬን ፋንታ በማሌዥያ እንደሚካሄድ አስታውቀዋል። ውድድሩ በጥቅምት 4 በሴፓንግ ወረዳ የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ በይፋዊ ስሙም የባህሬን ግራንድ ፕሪክስ በኩዋላምፑር ተብሎ ይጠራል። ይህ ውሳኔ በምስራቅ መካከለኛው ክፍል ባለው የጸጥታ ስጋት ምክንያት ለተስተጓጎለው የውድድር መርሃ ግብር ማስተካከያ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Formulaa Waanii akka ibsanitti, waldhabdee naannichaa irraa kan ka'e kan haqamee ture 'Bahrain Grand Prix' qophiin isaa jijjiiramee ji'a Onkololeessaa keessa Maaleeshiyaatti akka gaggeeffamu murtaa'eera. Ifatti 'Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia' jedhamee kan moggaafame kun, Onkololeessa 4, 2026 magaalaa Kuwaalaampuuritti argamuun kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Murtuun kun mootummoota biyyoota lamaanii fi qindeessitoota ispoortichaa gidduutti walii galtee irra ga'ame irratti kan hundaa'e dha.

title: Anti-war protesters demand end to US use of UK airbase to strike Iran
english: Anti-war activists recently gathered outside a military base in the United Kingdom to protest the potential use of the facility by American forces for airstrikes against Iran. The demonstrators are concerned about the regional risks, especially after Iranian officials cautioned that nations supporting such military operations could face direct retaliation. The protest highlights growing public opposition to the involvement of UK-based sites in ongoing Middle East conflicts.
amharic: የጦርነት ተቃዋሚ አክቲቪስቶች የአሜሪካ ጦር በኢራን ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም የብሪታንያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያን እንዳይጠቀም በመቃወም ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ኢራን እንዲህ ያሉ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን የሚደግፉ ሀገራት ኢላማ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ማስጠንቀቂያ ከሰጠች በኋላ ተቃውሞው ተጠናክሯል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የእንግሊዝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለሚካሄዱ ግጭቶች መጠቀማቸው አደገኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni mormii waraanaa irratti hirmaatan, waraanni Amerikaa buufata waraanaa biyya Ingilizi fayyadamuun Iran irratti haleellaa akka hin raawwanne gaafataniiru. Iran biyyoota haleellaa kanaaf buufata waraanaa isaanii hayyamaniin irratti tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamu akeekkachiisuun ishee hiriirtonni kun yaaddoo akka qabaatan godheera. Hiriirtonni kunneen buufataalee waraanaa Ingilizi keessatti argaman walitti bu'iinsa giddu galeessa bahaa keessatti hirmaachuun isaa balaa guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Female football referee suffers concussion amid male players’ melee
english: During a friendly football match in France, referee Mathilde Demoncay suffered a concussion after being knocked to the ground while trying to stop a brawl between male players. The incident occurred after a physical confrontation escalated on the field, forcing the referee to leave the game at halftime. Medical staff attended to her on the pitch, and the match continued only after she was replaced.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ በተካሄደ የወዳጅነት የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ወቅት፣ ዋና ዳኛ ማቲልድ ዴሞንካይ በወንድ ተጫዋቾች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት ጣልቃ ለመግባት ስትሞክር በደረሰባት አደጋ የጭንቅላት ጉዳት አጋጥሟታል። ግጭቱ የተከሰተው በተጫዋቾች መካከል በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ሲሆን፣ ዳኛዋ መሬት ላይ በመውደቋ ምክንያት ጨዋታውን መቀጠል አልቻለችም። የህክምና ባለሙያዎች በሜዳው ላይ የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ ካደረጉላት በኋላ፣ በግማሽ ሰዓት እረፍት ጊዜ ከጨዋታው ውጪ ሆናለች።
oromo: Faransaatti tapha kubbaa miillaa michummaa irratti, abbaan murtii Mathilde Demoncay jedhamtu taphatoota dhiiraa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi yeroo uumamu tasgabbeessuuf yaaltuun miidhama mataa guddaa irra ga'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan uumame erga taphatoonni lama wal qabachuu jalqabanii booda yoo ta'u, isheenis lafatti kuftee miidhamuun ishee taphicha itti fufuu akka hin dandeenye godheera. Gareen fayyaa ishee erga yaalanii booda, isheenis harka irratti yeroo boqonnaa dura taphicha gadhiisuun dirqamtee jirti.

title: Why the UK cancelled a military exercise in Kenya – and what it means
english: The United Kingdom has called off a scheduled military training exercise in Kenya due to ongoing disputes regarding legal jurisdiction and accountability. Kenyan lawmakers have expressed concerns over the existing defense agreement, specifically demanding better oversight for British soldiers stationed in the country. These tensions highlight significant friction in the long-standing military partnership between the two nations.

oromo: Mootummaan UK qophiin waraanaa Keeniyaa keessatti gaggeeffamuuf ture dhimma seerummaa fi itti gaafatamummaa waraana ishee irratti wal-dhabdee uumameen kan kansaareedha. Miseensonni mana maree Keeniyaa waligaltee waraanaa amma jiru irratti yaaddoo qaban ibsuun, waraanni Biritishii biyyattii keessa jiran akka itti gaafataman seerri ifa ta'e akka jiraatu gaafataniiru. Wal-dhabdeen kun hariiroo waraanaa waggoota dheeraaf biyyoota lamaan gidduu ture irratti dhiibbaa uumeera.

title: After Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea, has Iran war now reached Caspian Sea?
english: Ukraine recently attacked an Iranian commercial ship in the Caspian Sea, resulting in casualties and prompting a strong condemnation from Tehran. This event has raised concerns that the Caspian, previously considered a secure trade route, may become a new battleground as the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine continue to intersect. By targeting this corridor, Kyiv is increasing economic pressure on Iran, further complicating the country's strategic situation alongside existing tensions in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Lebanon's army condemns Israeli attacks preventing deployment in south
english: The Lebanese military has criticized Israel for ongoing military actions in southern Lebanon, stating these activities violate international law and existing agreements. The army claims that persistent shelling and destruction are actively hindering its ability to deploy troops to the region as planned. Consequently, these security challenges continue to prevent displaced local residents from safely returning to their homes.

title: Netanyahu says Israel 'prepared to act more broadly' in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced that the military is ready to expand its operations within the occupied West Bank. This decision follows a recent increase in violence involving both military raids and attacks by settlers against Palestinians. The government has directed security forces to conduct village searches, confiscate weapons, and carry out more arrests.

title: Lindsey Graham's legacy: Relentless warmongering dressed in folksy charm
english: Senator Lindsey Graham has passed away, drawing tributes from political colleagues who praised his personality despite his controversial legacy. While many officials remembered him as a friendly and cooperative legislator, critics highlight his role in promoting military interventionism and aggressive foreign policy. His career is often defined by a divide between his friendly public image and the destructive impact of the wars he supported.

Jireenyi siyaasaa isaanii, gama tokkoon namoota waliin walitti dhufeenya gaarii qabaachuu isaanii, gama biraatiin immoo waraana biyyoota gara garaa keessatti gaggeeffame irratti qooda fudhachuu isaaniin kan beekamu dha.

title: Settler attacks on Palestinians soar by 63 percent in first half of 2026
english: Violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians has risen significantly, with reports indicating a 63 percent increase in attacks during the first half of 2026. Recent events included the killing of four Palestinians, dozens of arrests, and the burning of mosques in the West Bank. International observers have strongly criticized these actions, labeling the escalating situation as a series of dangerous nationalist crimes.

Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi gareewwan mirga namoomaa gocha kana balaaleffachuun, haalli kun hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu gaafataniiru.

title: US says it will maintain Iran naval blocakade, redirects 12 vessels
english: The U.S. military has confirmed it is continuing its naval blockade against Iran to enforce maritime restrictions. Officials reported that they have successfully redirected a dozen commercial ships, disabled two non-compliant vessels, and boarded two others. Furthermore, forces intercepted a ship in the Strait of Hormuz after the crew repeatedly ignored warnings and attempted to breach the blockade.

title: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
english: A tragic attack occurred at a Berlin Pride event on Saturday night when a driver rammed a vehicle into a crowd, resulting in one death and 16 injuries, with some victims also suffering stab wounds. Police have launched an extensive city-wide manhunt for a 21-year-old suspect identified as having potential links to extremist groups. Authorities have recovered the vehicle used in the attack and are investigating the possibility that multiple individuals were involved.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
english: Palestinian officials report that Israeli settlers have burned two mosques, vehicles, and farmland across West Bank villages following a deadly clash that left six people dead. Settlers also vandalized property and left hateful graffiti, heightening the existing tensions in the region. While the Israeli military has launched an investigation, the area continues to experience a surge in violence and retaliatory actions from both sides.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ በተፈጠረ የሁለት ወገን ግጭት ስድስት ሰዎች ከሞቱ በኋላ፣ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ሁለት መስጊዶችን፣ መኪናዎችን እና የእርሻ መሬቶችን አቃጥለዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ በግንባታ ላይ ያሉ ህንጻዎችን በማውደም እና ጥላቻን የሚያንጸባርቁ ጽሁፎችን በመጻፍ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሰዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ምርመራ እንደሚጀምር ቢገልጽም፣ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭት እና የጥቃት ድርጊቶች እየተባባሱ ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Falasxiin akka ibsanitti, walitti bu’iinsa lubbuu namoota jahaa galaafate booda, qubattoonni Israa’el gandoota daangaa Lixaa keessatti masjiidota lama, konkolaataalee fi lafa qonnaa gubaniiru. Qubattoonni kun qabeenya mancaasuu fi ergaalee jibbiinsaa barreessuun tasgabbii dhabuu naannichaa caalaatti hammaachiisaniiru. Waraanni Israa’el qorannoo akka jalqabu beeksisee kan jiru ta’us, walitti bu’iinsii fi gochawwan haleellaa gandaa gandaan walirraa hin citne kun itti fufee jira.

title: Japanese football legend ‘King Kazu’, 59, scores first goal in four years
english: Japanese football icon Kazuyoshi Miura, known as King Kazu, has scored a competitive goal at 59 years old during a 7-0 victory for Fukushima United. This achievement marks his first goal in nearly four years as he continues his historic professional career. The veteran athlete plans to keep playing until at least his 60th birthday, currently extending his stay with the third-division club until mid-2027.
amharic: የጃፓኑ የእግር ኳስ አፈ ታሪክ ካዙዮሺ ሚዩራ በ59 ዓመቱ በፉኩሺማ ዩናይትድ 7-0 የድል ጨዋታ ላይ ጎል በማስቆጠር አስገራሚ ብቃቱን አሳይቷል። ይህ ግብ አትሌቱ በአራት ዓመታት ውስጥ ያስመዘገበው የመጀመሪያው የውድድር ግብ ነው። በ60 ዓመታቸው እስኪደርሱ ድረስ መጫወታቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ የገለጹት ሚዩራ፣ እስከ ሰኔ 2027 ድረስ ከክለቡ ጋር በመቆየት ረጅሙን የስፖርት ህይወታቸውን እያራዘሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Leenjisaan kubbaa miillaa biyya Jaappaan Kazuyoshi Miura, umrii waggaa 59tti tapha garee Fukushima United irratti goolii galchuun seenaa hojjateera. Taphataan kun goolii kanaan waggoota afur keessatti goolii jalqabaa galcheera. Kaazuu waggaa 60 guutuu isaatti taphachuu akka itti fufu ibsee, hanga bara 2027tti garee Fukushima waliin turuuf walii galeera.

title: Photos: Wildfires in France drive 250,000 people from their homes
english: Severe wildfires in southwestern France have forced approximately 250,000 residents to abandon their homes as flames move closer to the city of Bordeaux. Powerful winds have caused the fires to spread rapidly, prompting officials to order further evacuations and close major transport routes. Similar dangerous fire conditions have also impacted neighboring Spain, leading to significant displacements in the region.
amharic: በደቡብ ምዕራብ ፈረንሳይ የተቀሰቀሰው የደን ቃጠሎ ወደ ቦርዶ ከተማ በመጠጋቱ ወደ 250,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ተገደዋል። ጠንካራ የንፋስ አቅጣጫዎች እሳቱ በፍጥነት እንዲስፋፋ በማድረጋቸው ባለስልጣናት ተጨማሪ የመልቀቂያ ትዕዛዞችን አስተላልፈው ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን ዘግተዋል። ተመሳሳይ አስጊ የሆነ የእሳት አደጋ በአጎራባችዋ ስፔንም ተከስቶ በብዙ ሺህ የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለስደት ዳርጓል።
oromo: ibidda bosonaa kibba-lixaa Faransaayitti ka'een namoonni 250,000 ol ta'an mana isaanii gadi lakkisanii ba'uuf dirqamaniiru. ibidichi gara magaalaa Bordooitti dhihaachaa waan jiruuf, qilleensi cimaan babal'achuu ibidichaa ariifachiiseera. kana malees, qondaaltoonni nageenyaa karaalee gurguddaa cufuun uummata baqachiisaa jiru. rakkoon ibiddaa walfakkaatu biyya ollaa Ispeen keessattis uumamee namoota hedduu qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqiseera.

title: Israeli protesters denounce deadly settler violence
english: A group of Israeli activists gathered in Tel Aviv to demonstrate against the increasing violence committed by settlers in the occupied West Bank. This protest followed a fatal clash involving settlers near the Palestinian community of Tal. During the event, Israeli law enforcement officials took several of the protesters into custody.
amharic: የእስራኤል አክቲቪስቶች በቴል አቪቭ በመሰብሰብ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክልል በአምባገነን ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ይህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ የተካሄደው በታል ፍልስጤማውያን መንደር አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ ገዳይ ግጭት ምክንያት ነው። በሰልፉ ወቅት የእስራኤል ፖሊስ በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni Israa'el tokko tokko magaalaa Tel Aviv keessatti walitti qabuun, naannoo West Bank kan qabame keessatti gochaa jeequmsa fi hiraarsa onne-laaftoota (settlers) irratti mormii dhageessisaniiru. Mormiin kun kan ka'e, ganda Falasxiin kan ta'e 'Tal' jedhamu biratti walitti buiinsa lubbuu namaa galaafate booda. Hiriira kana irratti poolisiin Israa'el hiriirtoota muraasa to'annaa jala oolchaniiru.

title: The Cockroach Effect: Modi vs India’s Gen Z
english: A youth-led movement in India known as the Cockroach Janta Party is organizing massive student protests to voice frustration over systemic exam leaks. Despite facing a harsh government crackdown and limited support from mainstream media, these young demonstrators remain resilient against intimidation. This movement highlights a growing divide between the Indian government and a generation that is increasingly unwilling to stay silent.
amharic: በህንድ ውስጥ 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' የሚል መጠሪያ ያለው የወጣቶች ንቅናቄ፣ በመንግስት ፈተናዎች ላይ የተፈጠረውን የጥያቄ መፍሰስ በመቃወም ከፍተኛ የተማሪዎች ሰልፎችን እያካሄደ ነው። መንግስት ተቃውሞውን በአመፅ ለመጨፍለቅ ቢሞክርም እና ዋና ዋና የመገናኛ ብዙሃን ለጉዳዩ ትኩረት ባይሰጡም፣ ወጣቶቹ ከወትሮው በተለየ መልኩ ለመሸማቀቅ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ይህ ክስተት በህንድ መንግስት እና መብታቸውን በድፍረት በሚጠይቁ ወጣቶች መካከል እየሰፋ የመጣውን ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti gareen dargaggootaa 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu, rakkoo keessa deebii qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti uumame mormuuf hiriira guddaa gaggeessaa jira. Mootummaan tarkaanfii cimaa fudhatee fi miidiyaaleen gurguddoon akkaataa barbaadametti gabaasaa baatanis, dargaggoonni kun sodaatanii callisuu didaniiru. Sochiin kun mootummaa fi dhaloota haaraa gidduutti walitti buutiin fi garaagarummaan akkamitti akka dabalaa jiru ifa godha.

title: Thousands rally against Tunisia’s president five years after power grab
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in the Tunisian capital to protest against President Kais Saied five years after he took control of the government. The protesters called for his resignation, citing concerns over economic struggles, political oppression, and the erosion of democratic rights. Using slogans from the 2011 uprising, the crowd expressed their frustration with the current state of the nation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ ስልጣን ከተቆጣጠሩ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ በቱኒዚያ ዋና ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ፣ የፖለቲካ ጭቆና እና የዴሞክራሲ መዳከም በመታየቱ ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ ጠይቀዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ የ2011ቱን አብዮት መፈክር በመጠቀም በመንግስት ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በግልፅ ገልፀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Kaayis Saayid aangoo qabatanii waggaa shan booda, magaalaa guddittii Tuniiziyaatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman mormii dhageessisaniiru. Mormitootni kun rakkoo diinagdee, cunqursa siyaasaa fi hir'ina dimokiraasii biyyattii keessa jiruun walqabatee pireezidaantichi aangoo gadi akka lakkisan gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni kun mormii isaanii ibsuuf jechoota jijjiirama bara 2011 itti fayyadamaniin mormii isaanii agarsiisaniiru.

title: Watch: At the scene of Berlin Pride attack as manhunt continues
english: A major manhunt is currently underway in Berlin following a vehicle attack at a Pride event that resulted in one death and sixteen injuries. Authorities have identified a 21-year-old suspect named Abdul B. and are actively searching for him. The car believed to be involved in the incident was discovered by police within the city's Tiergarten park.
amharic: በበርሊን በተካሄደ የግብረ-ሰዶማውያን (Pride) ዝግጅት ላይ በተሽከርካሪ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት 16 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የጀርመን ፖሊስ አብዱል ቢ የተባለ የ21 ዓመት ወጣት ተጠርጣሪ መሆኑን በመለየት ፍለጋውን ቀጥሏል። ለጥቃቱ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል ተብሎ የተጠረጠረው ተሽከርካሪም በከተማዋ ቲየርጋርተን ፓርክ ውስጥ ተገኝቷል።
oromo: Maqaan magaalaa Barlinitti ayyaana 'Pride' irratti konkolaataan namoota irra bu'uun lubbuu nama tokkoo darbee namoota 16 irratti miidhaa geessisee jira. Poolisiin biyyattii dargaggeessa waggaa 21 kan ta'e Abdul B. jedhamu shakkamuu ibsuun, ammatti isa barbaacha jira. Konkolaataan yakka kanaaf itti fayyadame jedhamee shakkamu, paarkii Barlin kan ta'e Tiergarten keessatti argameera.

title: France battles fire 'whirlwinds' as another 55,000 evacuated
english: France is experiencing one of its most severe wildfire crises since World War II, forcing the evacuation of another 55,000 people near Bordeaux. Firefighters are struggling to contain the flames, which are being spread by erratic winds and dry conditions that have created dangerous fire whirlwinds. Both France and Spain have deployed significant resources and military assistance to combat the spreading infernos as authorities warn that the situation could remain critical for some time.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ ካጋጠማት እጅግ የከፋ የእሳት አደጋ ጋር እየታገለች ሲሆን፣ በቦርዶ አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ተጨማሪ 55,000 ሰዎች እንዲለቁ ተደርጓል። እሳቱ ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታ እና ጠንካራ ነፋስ በመኖሩ ምክንያት በቀላሉ የማይገታ እና አደገኛ የሆኑ የእሳት አዙሪቶችን እየፈጠረ ይገኛል። ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን ሰፊ የሰው ኃይል እና ወታደራዊ ድጋፍን በማሰባሰብ እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ ሁኔታው ለረጅም ጊዜ አሳሳቢ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Faransaayiin waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda balaa ibiddaa hammaataa ishee mudateen waldhabdee keessa kan jirtu yoo ta'u, namoonni dabalataa 55,000 ta'an naannoo Bordootti argaman bakka isaanii gadhiisanii ba'aniiru. Qilleensii cimaa fi gogiinsi naannichaa ibidda kana to'achuun akka nama rakkisuu fi bubbee ibiddaa uumuun balaa kan hammeesse yoo ta'u, Faransaayiin fi Ispeen gargaarsa waraanaa fi meeshaalee gahaa fayyadamuun ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii irra jiru. Haala kanaan itti fufuu fi to'annoo jala oolchuun yeroo dheeraa akka fudhatu hooggantoonni akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Israel raids West Bank live: Dozens of Palestinians detained during assault
english: Israeli military forces conducted a large-scale operation in the occupied West Bank city of Nablus, resulting in the arrest of approximately 40 Palestinian individuals. Among those detained were a woman and several people who had previously served time in prison. Additionally, reports indicate that Israeli settlers have moved to build a new unauthorized outpost on Palestinian-owned land in the Salfit region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ ከተማ ባካሄዱት መጠነ ሰፊ ዘመቻ ወደ 40 የሚጠጉ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ከተያዙት መካከል አንዲት ሴት እና ቀደም ሲል በእስር ላይ የቆዩ ግለሰቦች ይገኙበታል። በተጨማሪም፣ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በሳልፊት ክልል በሚገኝ የፍልስጤማውያን መሬት ላይ አዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መመስረታቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Naablus kan naannoo Lixaa kan qabame keessatti tarkaanfii bal'aa fudhataniin namoota Palastinaa 40 ta'an to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoota to'ataman kana keessatti dubartii tokko fi namoota kanaan dura hidhamanii turan hedduutu argamu. Kana malees, qonnaan bultoonni Israa'el lafa namoota Palastinaa kan aanaa Salfit irratti qubannaa haaraa seeraan alaa ijaaruu gabaafameera.

title: Tour de France final stage shortened as emergency teams tackle wildfires
english: The final stage of the Tour de France has been significantly reduced in length to allow security personnel to assist with emergency efforts against widespread wildfires. Organizers shortened the race route so that redirected law enforcement can focus on protecting communities affected by the fires in southwestern France. Despite the adjustments, the competition will still conclude as planned at the Champs-Elysees.
amharic: የቱር ደ ፍራንስ የመጨረሻው ውድድር በፈረንሳይ እየተስፋፉ ባሉ የዱር እሳቶች ሳቢያ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ተጎጂ አካባቢዎች እንዲዛወሩ ለማድረግ አጭር ሆኗል። የውድድሩ አዘጋጆች የፀጥታ ኃይሉ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ስራዎችን እንዲያግዝ በመወሰናቸው የውድድር መስመሩን ቀንሰዋል። ለውጡ ቢደረግም ውድድሩ እንደታቀደው በሻምዝ ኤሊዜ ይጠናቀቃል።
oromo: Guyyaan dhumaa fiixee duula baayiskilii Tour de France, ibiddi bosonaa gara garaatti ka'e to'achuuf gargaarsa nageenyaa barbaachisuun walqabatee gabaabateera. Gurmeessitoonni dorgommichaa humnoonni nageenyaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf akka bobba'an gargaaruuf jecha daandii dorgommichaas gabaabsuu murteessaniiru. Jijjiirama kana hunda walin, dorgommichi akkaataa karoora duraatti Champs-Elysees irratti xumurama.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosque in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to the Al-Rahma Mosque located in Qusra, near Nablus, in the occupied West Bank. This incident occurred alongside a widespread military crackdown by Israeli forces throughout the region. Tensions have escalated significantly following a violent shooting that resulted in multiple deaths on both sides.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ቁስራ የተባለ አካባቢ አል-ራህማ መስጂድን በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። ይህ ክስተት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በክልሉ ውስጥ በስፋት ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እየወሰዱ ባለበት ወቅት የተፈጠረ ነው። በሁለቱም ወገን የሰው ህይወት የጠፋበት የተኩስ ልውውጥ ከተፈጠረ በኋላ ውጥረቱ በእጅጉ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Qotee bultoonni Israa'el naannoo Qusra kan Nablusitti argamu masjiida Al-Rahma jedhamu gubaniiru. Gochi kun kan raawwatame loltoonni Israa'el naannicha keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa bal'aa fudhachaa jiranuun walqabatee dha. Rakkoon kun kan hammaate erga dhukaasa namoota hedduu ajjeese tokko booda dha.

title: Cape Verde World Cup star Vozinha agrees deal with Chile’s Colo Colo
english: Cape Verde's 40-year-old goalkeeper, Vozinha, has signed a contract with the Chilean football club Colo Colo following his outstanding performance at the World Cup. After helping his national team reach the knockout stages, the veteran player will travel to Santiago for a medical exam before officially joining the team. His impressive skills and viral popularity have made him a global sensation, leading to this high-profile move to one of Chile’s most successful clubs.
amharic: የኬፕ ቨርዴው የ40 ዓመት ግብ ጠባቂ ቮዚንሃ በአለም ዋንጫው ላይ ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት ተከትሎ ከቺሊው ክለብ ኮሎ ኮሎ ጋር ስምምነት ላይ ደርሷል። ብሔራዊ ቡድኑን ወደ ጥሎ ማለፍ እንዲያልፍ የረዳው ይህ ተጫዋች፣ በይፋ ከመቀላቀሉ በፊት በሳንቲያጎ የህክምና ምርመራ ያደርጋል። በውድድሩ ባሳየው አስደናቂ ብቃት እና በተፈጠረለት ከፍተኛ ዝና ምክንያት፣ ወደ ቺሊ ስኬታማ ክለቦች አንዱ በመዛወሩ በስፖርቱ አለም ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Golkeeper'n biyya Keep Veerdee kan umuriin isaa waggaa 40 ta'e Vozinha, tapha guddicha Waancaa Addunyaarratti dandeettii ajaa'ibsiisaa agarsiise booda kilabii Chiilii Colo Colo waliin waliigaltee mallatteesseera. Garee biyyoolessaa isaa gara sadarkaa itti aanuutti ce'uuf gumaacha guddaa kan godhe taphataan kun, erga qormaata fayyaa fudhateen booda gara kilabichaa kan makamu ta'a. Dandeettii inni agarsiise fi beekamtii inni hawaasa keessatti argate kanaan, gara kilabii beekamaa fi milkaa'aa ta'e kanatti makachuun isaa addunyaa kubbaa miillaa keessatti haasawa guddaa uumeera.

title: Joshua comes back twice to knock out Prenga and set up Fury showdown
english: Anthony Joshua made a dramatic return to boxing in Saudi Arabia by overcoming two early knockdowns to secure a second-round knockout victory over Kristian Prenga. This win marks Joshua's comeback following a serious car accident and keeps his anticipated future fight against Tyson Fury on track. Both fighters have now successfully cleared their warm-up matches, setting the stage for a highly anticipated showdown later this year.
amharic: አንቶኒ ጆሹዋ በሳውዲ አረቢያ በተደረገ የቦክስ ግጥሚያ በሁለት ዙር ሁለት ጊዜ ተንኳኳ ቢሆንም፣ በመጨረሻ ክርስቲያን ፕሬንጋን በሁለተኛው ዙር በማሸነፍ አስደናቂ ብቃት አሳይቷል። ይህ ድል ጆሹዋ ከደረሰበት የትራፊክ አደጋ ማገገሙን ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ከታይሰን 퓨ሪ ጋር ለሚጠበቀው ትልቅ ግጥሚያም መንገዱን ክፍት አድርጎለታል። ሁለቱም ቦክሰኞች በቅርቡ ያደረጉትን የዝግጅት ግጥሚያ በማሸነፋቸው፣ በዘንድሮው ዓመት መጨረሻ ላይ እርስ በርስ የሚጋጠሙበት ዕድል ሰፊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Antoonii Jooshuwaan Sa'udii Arabiyaatti qindaa'e tapha booksii irratti, erga si'a lama gadi kufee booda injifannoo ajaa'ibaa argachuun Kristiyaan Pireengaa raawwateera. Injifannoon kun erga balaa konkolaataa cimaa booda gara dirree booksii deebi'uu isaa kan mirkaneessu yoo ta'u, qophii gara fuulduraatti Taayisan Fyuurii wajjin gochuuf karoorsuufis karaa banera. Boksoonnii lamaanuu taphoota qophii isaanii milkaa'inaan xumuruun, dhuma waggaa kanaatti wal arguuf haala mijeessaniiru.

title: House of Hope: New film follows a Waldorf-inspired school in the West Bank
english: A new documentary titled House of Hope highlights a Waldorf-inspired school in the occupied West Bank founded by Manar Wahhab and her husband. The film captures the challenges of providing a nurturing education to Palestinian children struggling with the trauma of living under military occupation. By using the Waldorf approach, the school serves as a safe environment where students can process their emotions and maintain a sense of agency despite their difficult circumstances.
amharic: ሃውስ ኦፍ ሆፕ የተሰኘ አዲስ ዘጋቢ ፊልም በማናር ዋሃብ እና በባለቤቷ በዌስት ባንክ የተቋቋመውን የዋልዶርፍ ትምህርት ቤት እንቅስቃሴ ይዳስሳል። ፊልሙ በትጥቅ ትግል እና በወረራ ስር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ህጻናት የሚያጋጥሟቸውን ተግዳሮቶች እና በትምህርት ቤቱ የሚያገኙትን ድጋፍ ያሳያል። የዋልዶርፍ ፍልስፍናን በመጠቀም ትምህርት ቤቱ ህጻናት ስሜታቸውን እንዲገልጹ እና በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥም ቢሆን የራሳቸው የሆነ የመማሪያ ቦታ እንዲኖራቸው ይረዳል።
oromo: Fiilmiin haaraa 'House of Hope' jedhamu mana barumsaa Waldorf hordofuun kan hundeeffame biyya keenya jala jiru keessatti Manar Wahhab fi abbaa manaa ishiitiin akka ta'e ibsa. Fiilmiichi ijoolleen Falasxiin weerara jala jiraachuu irraa miidhaa fi dhiphina irra gahu akkamitti akka dandamatan fi mana barumsichaan deggersa akka argatan agarsiisa. Mala barnoota Waldorf fayyadamuun, mana barumsichi ijoolleen miira isaanii akka ibsatanii fi haala ulfaataa keessattillee tasgabbii akka argatan taasisa.

title: Typhoon Noul makes landfall in China, with hundreds of thousands evacuated
english: Typhoon Noul has struck southern China and Hong Kong, marking the strongest storm to reach the country so far this year. Authorities have evacuated over 700,000 residents in Guangdong province to ensure public safety as the storm brought intense winds and heavy rainfall. While the typhoon is now gradually weakening while moving inland, it has caused flight cancellations, property damage, and several injuries across the region.
amharic: ቲፎን ናውል የቻይናን ደቡባዊ ክፍል እና ሆንግ ኮንግን በመምታቱ በዚህ አመት በሀገሪቱ የደረሰ ከፍተኛው አውሎ ንፋስ ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት በጓንግዶንግ ግዛት ውስጥ ከ700,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎችን ደህንነታቸውን ለመጠበቅ ከቀያቸው አፈናቅለዋል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ወደ ውስጥ በሚንቀሳቀስበት ወቅት እየተዳከመ ቢሆንም፣ በክልሉ የበረራ ስረዛዎችን፣ የንብረት ውድመትን እና የተወሰኑ የአካል ጉዳቶችን አስከትሏል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Noul jedhamu kibba Chaayinaa fi Hong Kong rukutee, obomboleetii waggaa kana keessa biyyattii rukute keessaa isa cimaa ta'ee jira. Bulchiinstonni naannoo Guangdong keessatti namoota 700,000 ol ta'an balaa irraa oolchuuf iddoo isaanii irraa kaasuun iddoo mijataa gadi dhaaban. Obomboleettiin kun yeroo amma qilleensa gadi fageenya biyyaatti deemuun laafachaa kan jiru ta'us, balaliin xiyyaaraa akka dhaabbatu, qabeenyarratti miidhaan akka ga'uu fi namoonni muraasni miidhamuu isaanii gabaasameera.

english: Severe wildfires in Spain have resulted in at least 14 deaths and widespread destruction. The situation worsened as two large fires combined, spreading toward neighboring regions and necessitating the evacuation of tens of thousands of residents. Emergency teams are currently working to contain the spreading inferno.
amharic: በስፔን እየተከሰቱ ባሉ ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ሁለት ትላልቅ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች ተቀላቅለው ወደ ጎረቤት አካባቢዎች በመስፋፋታቸው በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ተደርገዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ispaan keessatti ibiddi bosonaa cimaan uumame lubbuu namoota 14 galaafateera. Ibiddoonni gurguddoon lama walitti makamuun gara naannoo ollaa babal'achaa waan jiruuf, namoonni kumaatamaan lakka'aman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: New front in US-Iran war escalates as Houthis fire at Saudi oil facilities
english: The conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran has intensified as Houthi rebels in Yemen launched drone and missile attacks against key Saudi Arabian oil sites. Although US airstrikes on Iran have paused, the previous collapse of peace talks and ongoing regional instability continue to threaten global energy and food security. The situation remains volatile as multiple proxy groups align with Iran, leading to widespread disruptions across the Middle East.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማቀነባበሪያ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሷል። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ የሚካሄደው የአየር ጥቃት ለጊዜው ቢቆምም፣ የሰላም ንግግሮች በመቋረጣቸው እና ቀጣናዊ አለመረጋጋት በመስፋፋቱ የአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እና የምግብ ዋስትና ስጋት ላይ ወድቋል። ይህ ውጥረት መካከለኛው ምስራቅን ለከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋት የዳረገ ሲሆን ግጭቱም እየተስፋፋ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mormitoonni Huutii Yemen keessa jiran buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti weerara dhiyeessii fi miisaayilii gaggeessuun walitti bu'iinsi Ameerikaa, Israa'elii fi Iraan gidduu jiru hammaatee jira. Ameerikaan weerara qilleensa irraa Iraan irratti gaggeessaa turte yeroof dhaabbatus, mariin nagaa diigamuu fi tasgabbii dhabuun naannichaa gabaa boba'aa fi nageenya nyaataa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira. Haalli kun naannicha keessatti walitti bu'iinsa itti fufe akka hammaatu taasisee jira.

title: US military disables tanker accused of breaking the Iran blockade
english: The United States military has taken action against commercial vessels suspected of violating its naval blockade on Iran. According to CENTCOM, forces boarded one tanker and disabled another after they refused to comply with instructions. In total, authorities have redirected 12 ships as part of this ongoing enforcement operation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በኢራን ላይ የጣለውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ጥሰዋል በተባሉ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ እርምጃ ወስዷል። የሴንትኮም (CENTCOM) መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው አንድ መርከብ ተሳፍሮ በመያዝ ሌላኛውን ደግሞ መመሪያ ባለመቀበላቸው ምክንያት እንዲሰናከል አድርጓል። በአጠቃላይ ይህንን የቁጥጥር ስራ ለማስፈጸም 12 መርከቦች እንዲዞሩ ተደርገዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa dooniiwwan daldalaa daangaa galaanaasanii kan Iran irratti kaa'ame cabsuuf yaalanii jiran irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniiru. Gabaasni CENTCOM akka ibsutti, humnoonni waraanaa doonii tokko keessa seenuun to'atanii kan biraa immoo ajaja diduu isaaniitiin akka hin hojjenne godhaniiru. Waliigalaan, hojii kabachiisa seeraa kana keessatti dooniiwwan 12 kallattii isaanii akka jijjiiran dirqisiifamaniiru.

title: TPLF’s New Proclamation Codifies a Police State
english: The TPLF's recent Proclamation No. 366/2018 establishes a restrictive regional legal framework that grants authorities extreme powers, including warrantless arrests, media censorship, and the death penalty. Critics argue this law is unconstitutional because a regional state lacks the sovereign authority to legislate on national defense, treason, and capital punishment. Furthermore, the document is enforced by an illegitimate council, posing a severe threat to human rights and due process for the people of Tigray.
amharic: የህወሓት አዲሱ አዋጅ ቁጥር 366/2018 የክልሉን አስተዳደር ያለፍርድ ቤት ትእዛዝ የማሰር፣ ሚዲያዎችን የመቆጣጠር እና የሞት ቅጣት የመጣል ሰፊ ስልጣን ይሰጣል። የክልል መንግስት እንደ ሀገር መከላከያ፣ ክህደት እና የሞት ቅጣት ባሉ አበይት ጉዳዮች ላይ ህግ የማውጣት ስልጣን ስለሌለው ይህ አዋጅ ህገ-መንግስታዊ መሰረት የለውም። በተጨማሪም አዋጁን ያወጣው ምክር ቤት ህጋዊ እውቅና የሌለው በመሆኑ፣ በክልሉ ህዝብ መሰረታዊ መብቶች እና ፍትሃዊ የህግ ሂደት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል።
oromo: Labsiin haaraa TPLF lakk. 366/2018 baase kun mootummaan naannichaa ajaja mana murti malee nama hidhuu, miidiyaalee ukkaamsuu fi adaba du’aa murteessuu akka danda’u aangoo bal’aa kenna. Mootummaan naannoo tokko dhimmoota akka ittisa biyyaa, nageenyaa fi ajjeechaa irratti seera baasuuf aangoo waan hin qabneef, labsiin kun faallaa heera mootummaati. Kana malees, qaamni labsiin kun akka ba’u godhe kun harka aangoo seeraa kan hin qabne waan ta’eef, mirga namoomaa fi adeemsa sirrii kan ummata Tigraay irratti balaa guddaa qaba.

title: Ethiopia Cannot Afford Another Disaster
english: The author argues that Ethiopia is at a critical juncture where avoiding another conflict requires urgent leadership and genuine commitment to the Pretoria Agreement. Despite the end of major fighting, the country faces ongoing instability and humanitarian crises that threaten to unravel fragile peace efforts. To prevent a return to violence, political leaders must prioritize national stability over brinkmanship and work together to address the unresolved issues still affecting citizens.
amharic: ጸሐፊው ኢትዮጵያ አዲስ ግጭት ውስጥ እንዳትገባ የፕሪቶሪያውን ስምምነት በተግባር ላይ ማዋል እና ጥበብ የተሞላበት አመራር እንደሚያስፈልግ ይከራከራሉ። ዋናው ጦርነት ቢቆምም በሀገሪቱ ያለው አለመረጋጋት እና የዜጎች መከራ የሰላም ጥረቶችን አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። መሪዎች ለፖለቲካ ትርፍ ሲሉ አገሪቱን ወደ አደገኛ ሁኔታ ከመግፋት ተቆጥበው የጋራ ሰላምን ለማረጋገጥ ቅድሚያ መስጠት አለባቸው።
oromo: Barreessaan kun Itoophiyaan waraansa biraa keessa akka hin galleef waliigaltee Pretooriyaa hojiirra oolchuufi hogganoota ga'umsa qaban akka barbaachisu ibsa. Waraanni guddaan dhaabbatus, biyyattiin rakkoo nageenyaafi namoomaa keessa jirtu carraa nageenyaa miidhaa jira. Hogganoonni siyaasaa faayidaa dhuunfaaf jecha biyyaa fi ummata rakkoo keessa buusuu dhiisanii, nageenya biyyaa dursee akka irratti hojjetan gaafatama.

title: Can Zimbabwe’s mineral ambitions benefit smaller producers?
english: Zimbabwe is banning raw mineral exports to encourage local processing and boost the economy through domestic manufacturing. While the government has attracted significant foreign investment, particularly in lithium, smaller miners worry they lack the funds and infrastructure to keep up. These smaller operations fear they will be excluded from the new industry due to high operational costs and power supply issues.
amharic: ዚምባብዌ ከሀገር ውስጥ የሚወጡ ማዕድናትን በጥሬው ከመላክ ይልቅ በሀገር ውስጥ በማቀነባበር ኢኮኖሚዋን ለማሳደግ እየሰራች ነው። መንግስት በዚህ ዘርፍ ከፍተኛ የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት ቢስብም፣ አነስተኛ አምራቾች ግን ለስራው የሚያስፈልገው ገንዘብ እና የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል እጥረት እንደሚያጋጥማቸው ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። እነዚህ አነስተኛ ድርጅቶች በዘርፉ ለውጥ ተጠቃሚ ከመሆን ይልቅ የመገለል ስጋት እንዳላቸው ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Zimbaabween qabeenya albuudaa biyyattii gurgurtaa alaatti baasuun dura, biyyuma keessatti qindeessuun dinagdee cimsuuf karoora qabdi. Mootummaan invastimantii alaa hedduu kan hawwate ta’us, oomishitoota xixinnoo ta’an garuu baasii fi hanqina humna ibsaa irraa kan ka’e carraaqqii kana keessatti hirmaachuun akka isaan rakkisu dubbatu. Oomishitootni kunniin jijjiirama kanneen keessatti osoo hin hirmaatin akka hambifaman sodaatu.

title: French wildfires trigger mass evacuations around Bordeaux
english: Severe wildfires in southwestern France have forced approximately 200,000 residents to flee their homes. The massive flames have scorched nearly 98,000 hectares of land and caused the suspension of operations at Bordeaux Airport. Due to the scale of the destruction, the French government is currently requesting international assistance to help contain the fires.
amharic: በደቡብ ምዕራብ ፈረንሳይ የተቀሰቀሰው አሰቃቂ የእሳት አደጋ ወደ ሁለት መቶ ሺህ የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድዷል። ሰደድ እሳቱ ወደ ዘጠና ስምንት ሺህ ሄክታር የሚጠጋ መሬትን ያወደመ ሲሆን የቦርዶ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አገልግሎት እንዲቋረጥ አድርጓል። ጉዳቱ እጅግ ከፍተኛ በመሆኑ የፈረንሳይ መንግስት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Fransii kibba-dhihaatti balaan ibiddaa cimaan ka’ee namoota 200,000 ta’an bakka jireenyaa isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun lafa hektaara 98,000 ta’u barbadeessuun alatti, buufanni xiyyaaraa Boordoo akka cufamu godheera. Balaa kana to’achuuf mootummaan Fransii gargaarsa biyyoota alaa gaafachuu dirqameera.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro launches Brazil presidential bid with Milei support
english: Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of former Brazilian leader Jair Bolsonaro, has officially entered the race to challenge current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. He aims to promote his father's political ideology as he seeks the presidency. His campaign has already received public backing from Argentina's right-wing President, Javier Milei.
amharic: የቀድሞው የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንት የጃየር ቦልሶናሮ ልጅ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ፣ አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያሉትን ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫን ለመገዳደር የፕሬዚዳንትነት እጩነቱን ይፋ አድርጓል። ፍላቪዮ የአባቱን የፖለቲካ አቋም እንደሚቀጥል ቃል ገብቷል። የእጩነቱ ዘመቻ በአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ሀቪየር ሚሌይ ድጋፍ ተችሮታል።
oromo: Ilmi dura bu'aa biyya Brazil kan durii Jair Bolsonaro, Flavio Bolsonaro, filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyyattii irratti pirezidaantii amma jiran Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva wajjin akka dorgomu ifatti labseera. Flavio duula filannoo isaa kana keessatti ejjennoo siyaasaa abbaa isaa akka itti fufu ibseera. Duulli filannoo isaa kunis pirezidaantii Arjantiinaa kan ta'an Javier Milei biraa deeggarsa argateera.

title: Israel arrests nine at Tel Aviv protest against West Bank settler violence
english: Israeli police detained nine people during a demonstration in Tel Aviv where hundreds gathered to protest against settler violence and military actions in the West Bank. The protest followed a deadly confrontation in the village of Tal that resulted in the deaths of four Palestinians and two Israelis. In response to these events, the Israeli government launched a major military operation in the area, leading to dozens of arrests.
amharic: በቴል አቪቭ በተደረገ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ በምዕራብ ባንክ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጽሙትን ጥቃት ለመቃወም የወጡ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ሰልፉ የተካሄደው በታል መንደር በተከሰተ እና የሁለት እስራኤላውያንና የአራት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወት ካለፈበት ግጭት በኋላ ነው። ይህንን ተከትሎ የእስራኤል መንግስት በምዕራብ ባንክ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ የጀመረ ሲሆን በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያንንም አስሯል።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el namoota sagal Tel Avivitti hiriira mormii irratti argaman erga qabdee booda hidhe; kunis kan ta'e gocha humnoota mootummaa fi qotee bulaa Israa'el kan naannoo Lixaa Baankii irratti raawwatamu mormuuf ture. Hiriirri kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo Tal jedhamutti uumamee lubbuu namoota jahaa galaafate booda kan dhufe dha. Tarkaanfii kana hordofee, mootummaan Israa'el naannoo sanatti duula waraanaa bal'aa kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, namoota hedduus to'annaa jala oolcheera.

title: Yemen’s Houthis target Saudi oil facilities along the Red Sea
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have launched a series of drone and missile strikes against Saudi Aramco oil installations located near the Red Sea. Saudi officials confirmed the attacks occurred but successfully intercepted the incoming threats. This incident marks another escalation in the ongoing conflict between the two regional factions.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ የሳውዲ አራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ ድሮን እና ሚሳኤሎችን በመጠቀም ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ መፈጸሙን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ሚሳኤሎቹ እና ድሮኖቹ ከመድረሳቸው በፊት መመታታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni Huthota Yemen jiran qabeenya dhaabbata boba'aa Sawudii kan ta'e Aramco kan galaana diimaa cinaatti argamu irratti haleellaa rookeettii fi xiyyaara nama hin feenne (drone) raawwataniiru. Qondaalonni Sawudii haleellaan kun raawwatamuu isaa erga mirkaneessanii booda, miidhaan tokko illee akka hin geenyee fi meeshaaleen haleellaa sun karaatti akka fashaleeffaman ibsaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa gartuuwwan lamaan gidduu jiru daran kan hammaate ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Global Bank Board Suspends 18 as Deposit Probe Widens
english: Global Bank's board has suspended 18 senior executives, including President Tesfaye Boru, as part of an expanding investigation into the bank's deposit and liquidity operations. Following these suspensions, the board has appointed Sahilemichael Mekonnen to serve as the acting president. The management shake-up reflects the bank's efforts to address internal financial irregularities.
amharic: የግሎባል ባንክ የዳይሬክተሮች ቦርድ በባንኩ የተቀማጭ ገንዘብ እና የፈሳሽነት አያያዝ ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው ምርመራ ምክንያት 18 ከፍተኛ አመራሮችን አግዷል። ከታገዱት መካከል የባንኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶ/ር ተስፋዬ ቦሩ ይገኙበታል። ቦርዱ ሳህለሚካኤል መኮንንን በጊዜያዊነት የባንኩ ፕሬዝዳንት አድርጎ ሾሟል።
oromo: Boordiin Baankii Gloobal qorannoo hojii qabiyyee fi kaffaltii maallaqaa wajjin walqabatu bal'isuun hoggantoota olaanoo 18 ta'an hojiirraa uggureera. Hoggantoota ugguraman kana keessaa pirezidaantiin baankichaa Dr. Tasfayyee Boruu isaan tokko dha. Boordichi bakka isaanii bakka bu'uun Saahileemikaa'el Makonnin pirezidaantii ittaanaa ta'anii akka hojjetan muddeera.

title: Shematera Weavers’ Chain Meets the VAT Line
english: Hundreds of shops at Mercato’s Shematera textile market have been forced to close due to a new government tax enforcement campaign. Authorities are demanding that traders comply with VAT regulations, which conflicts with the traditional, informal business practices of the local weavers and sellers. This enforcement has brought significant disruption to one of the city's most historic trade hubs as sellers struggle to adapt to the formal receipt system.
amharic: በመርካቶ የሚገኘው የሸማተራ የጨርቃጨርቅ ገበያ፣ መንግሥት የግብር መሠረቱን ለማስፋት ባደረገው ዘመቻ ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሱቆች ተዘግተዋል። ባለስልጣናት ነጋዴዎች የቫት ደረሰኝ እንዲጠቀሙ በማስገደዳቸው፣ ከረጅም ጊዜ ወግ ጋር የተያያዘው መደበኛ ያልሆነው የግብይት ሥርዓት ተስተጓጉሏል። ይህ የሕግ ማስከበር ሥራ በአካባቢው የነበረውን የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ በመጉዳት ነጋዴዎችን ለችግር ዳርጓል።
oromo: Gabaa uffataa Shemataraa kan Merkatoo keessatti argamu keessatti, mootummaan dirqama gibiraa babal'isuuf tarkaanfii fudhateen suuqonni hedduun cufamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni daldaltoonni seera VAT akka kabajan dirqisiisuun isaanii, aadaa daldalaa baroota dheeraaf turee fi mallattoo malee gaggeeffamaa ture waliin wal-dhabbii uumeera. Tarkaanfiin kun gabaa seena-qabeessa kana keessatti sochii daldalaa waan dhaabeef, daldaltoonni jijjiirama kana keessatti rakkachaa jiru.

title: Hulu Sport Wins in Court, But Stays Closed
english: The Federal High Court has overturned the National Lottery Administration’s decision to shut down Hulu Sport, ruling that the initial suspension was unfair and lacked proper legal procedure. Despite this judicial victory, the betting company remains closed while the ruling raises concerns about the authority of government regulatory bodies. This outcome highlights the need for public agencies to follow transparent and lawful processes when dealing with private enterprises.
amharic: የፌዴራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የብሔራዊ ሎተሪ አስተዳደር ሁሉ ስፖርትን ለማገድ የወሰደውን እርምጃ ሕገ-ወጥ ነው በማለት ውሳኔውን ሽሯል። ኩባንያው ፍርድ ቤቱን ቢያሸንፍም፣ እስካሁን ድረስ አገልግሎት መስጠት አልቻለም። ይህ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ የመንግሥት ተቋማት በግል ድርጅቶች ላይ እርምጃ ሲወስዱ መከተል ስላለባቸው ሕጋዊ አሠራሮች ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federaalaatti murtee bulchiinsi looterii biyyaalessaa dhaabbata 'Hulu Sport' cufuuf dabarse seeraan alaa fi sirrii miti jechuun haqee jira. Dhaabbatichi mo'annoo seeraa argatus, hanga ammaatti hojii isaa itti fufuu hin dandeenye. Murteen kun qaamoleen mootummaa dhaabbata dhuunfaa irratti tarkaanfii yeroo fudhatan adeemsa ifaa fi seera qabeessa ta'e hordofuu akka qaban kan yaadachiisu dha.

title: Federal Regulation Grants Receipt for Farmers, a New Product for the Banks
english: The Ethiopian government has introduced a new regulation allowing farmers to use certified warehouse receipts as collateral for bank loans. This policy permits growers to borrow up to 70 percent of the value of their stored crops. The initiative aims to help farmers avoid selling their harvest at low prices during peak times by providing them with the cash needed for immediate expenses.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት አርሶ አደሮች የተረጋገጠ የክምችት ደረሰኝን ለባንክ ብድር መያዣነት እንዲጠቀሙ የሚያስችል አዲስ ደንብ አውጥቷል። በዚህ ደንብ መሰረት አርሶ አደሮች ከተከማቸው ምርት ዋጋ እስከ 70 በመቶ የሚደርስ ብድር ማግኘት ይችላሉ። ይህ መመሪያ አርሶ አደሮች ምርታቸውን በዝቅተኛ ዋጋ ከመሸጥ እንዲቆጠቡ በማድረግ፣ ለግብርና ግብዓቶች የሚያስፈልጋቸውን ገንዘብ እንዲያገኙ ይረዳቸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa qonnaan bultoonni ragaa kuusaa midhaanii wabii godhatanii baankii irraa liqii akka argatan seera haaraa baaseera. Haala kanaan qonnaan bultoonni midhaan kuusaa isaanii irraa harka 70 ga'u liqeeffachuu danda'u. Sirni kun qonnaan bultoonni yeroo midhaan baay'ee fi gatiin isaa gadi bu'etti ariifatanii akka hin gurgurre fi gargaarsa maallaqaa akka argatan taasisa.

title: Trucks Impounding Puts Fuel Carriers, Regulators at Legal Odds
english: The Ethiopian Bulk Fuel Transport Owners' Association is in a dispute with regulators over rising operational expenses and the seizure of their vehicles. Association leaders argue that current transport tariffs are outdated and fail to cover the increasing costs of fuel and vehicle maintenance. They also claim that authorities are unfairly impounding trucks, even when fuel has been imported legally and all necessary taxes have been paid.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ ተሽከርካሪዎች ባለቤቶች ማኅበር እየጨመረ ከመጣው የሥራ ማስኬጃ ወጪ እና ከተሽከርካሪዎች መወረስ ጋር በተያያዘ ከቁጥጥር አካላት ጋር አለመግባባት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። የማኅበሩ አመራሮች ነባሩ የትራንስፖርት ታሪፍ ወቅታዊ ስላልሆነ የነዳጅ እና የጥገና ወጪዎችን መሸፈን እንዳልቻለ ይገልጻሉ። እንዲሁም፣ ነዳጁ በሕጋዊ መንገድ የገባ እና ግብር የተከፈለበት ቢሆንም ባለሥልጣናት ያለምክንያት ተሽከርካሪዎችን እየያዙ ነው ሲሉ ቅሬታቸውን አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan abbootii qabeenyaa fe’umsa boba’aa Itoophiyaa, baasiin hojii dabaluu fi konkolaatonni isaanii butamuu irratti qaamolee bulchiinsa waliin wal dhabbii keessa galanii jiru. Hogganoonni gamtichaa akka jedhanitti, taariffiin geejjibaa yeroo ammaa hojii irra jiru kan darbe waan ta’eef, baasii boba’aa fi suphaa konkolaataa hin danda’u. Kana malees, boba’aan seeraan galii ta’ee fi gibirri isaa kan kaffalame ta’us, qaamoleen mootummaa konkolaataa isaanii akka tasaa akka qabatan komataniiru.

title: What’s behind the Israeli crackdown in the occupied West Bank?
english: Israeli military forces are conducting increased raids in the occupied West Bank while simultaneously speeding up the construction of illegal settlements. These actions are occurring alongside rising violence from Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the region. Analysts suggest that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu may be escalating these tensions to appeal to his right-wing supporters ahead of the upcoming national elections.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ወረራዎችን ያጠናከሩ ሲሆን ህገ-ወጥ የሰፈራ ግንባታዎችንም እያፋጠኑ ይገኛሉ። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ እየተካሄደ ያለው በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለሚቀጥለው ምርጫ ያላቸውን የቀኝ ዘመም ደጋፊዎች ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ይህንን ውጥረት እየተጠቀሙበት ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el naannoo West Bank keessatti duula isaa daran jabeesse kan jiru yoo ta'u, babal'ina buufataalee seeraan alaa saffisiisuus itti fufeera. Gochootni kun kan raawwatamanitti kan jiran yeroo haleellaan sirnaan alaa jiraattota Israa'el irraan Paalastinaawota irratti raawwatamu dabalaa jiruudha. Xiinxaltootni akka jedhanitti, Ministirri Muummee Benyaamin Netanyaahu adeemsa kana kan fayyadamaa jiran filannoo dhufuuf deemuuf deeggarsa warra yaada mirgaa (right-wing) of biratti horachuuf ta'uu mala.

title: Iran accuses Ukraine of deadly attack on Caspian commercial vessel
english: Iran has officially protested against Ukraine following an attack on an Iranian commercial ship in the Caspian Sea that resulted in one fatality and multiple injuries. Tehran condemned the incident as a criminal act and has called upon the international community and the UN to hold those responsible accountable. This development occurred after Ukrainian officials claimed success in long-range strikes against vessels involved in military shipments.
amharic: ኢራን በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ በሚገኝ የንግድ መርከቧ ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት አንድ መርከበኛ መሞቱንና ሌላው መቁሰሉን ተከትሎ በዩክሬን ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምታለች። ቴህራን ጥቃቱን የወንጀል ድርጊት ሲል በመፈረጅ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ተጠያቂዎችን ለፍርድ እንዲያቀርቡ ጠይቃለች። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ወታደራዊ ጭነት የሚያጓጉዙ መርከቦችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ካስታወቁ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Iiraan markaba ishee kan daldalaa galaana Kaspiyan keessatti haleelamee du'a hojjetaa tokkoo fi madaa'uu kan biraa geessise irratti mootummaa Yukreen irratti mormii dhageessisteetti. Teheran haleelaa kana gocha yakkaa jechuun balaaleffattee, hawaasni addunyaa fi Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii qaamota badii raawwatan akka gaafatan gaafatteetti.
