title: Fire tears through Indonesian village in West Java
english: A massive fire recently devastated a traditional village in Indonesia's West Java province. The blaze destroyed over 70 homes and left more than 400 residents without shelter. Authorities suspect that a faulty electrical connection was the primary cause of the incident.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ምዕራብ ጃቫ ግዛት በሚገኝ አንድ ባህላዊ መንደር ውስጥ በተነሳ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ከ70 በላይ ቤቶች ወድመዋል። አደጋው ከ400 በላይ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው ያፈናቀለ ሲሆን፣ የእሳቱ መነሻም የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር መበላሸት እንደሆነ ተገምቷል።
oromo: Indooneziyaa, godina Jaavaa Dhihaa keessatti balaan ibiddaa cimaan baadiyyaa aadaa tokko miidheera. Ibidni kun manneen 70 ol gubee namoota 400 ol ta'an immoo mana malee hambiseera. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, balaan kun kan uumame rakkoo quunnamtii elektirikii irraa akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Iranian army claims nearly all US infrastructure in Iraq's Erbil base 'destroyed'
english: A senior Iranian military official claims that recent strikes have successfully incapacitated major American facilities, specifically highlighting the near-total destruction of the base in Erbil, Iraq. Iran has vowed to keep conducting military operations if the current conflict persists. Their stated goal is to force the United States to abandon attempts to exert pressure on Iran through military force.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን በቅርቡ በተፈፀመ ጥቃት በኢራቅ ኤርቢል የሚገኘው የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈር ሙሉ በሙሉ መውደሙን ገልጸዋል። ኢራን አሁን ያለው ግጭት ከቀጠለ ወታደራዊ እርምጃቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። የዚህ ዘመቻ ዓላማ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ በጉልበት ለመጫን የምታደርገውን ጥረት እንዲያቆሙ ለማድረግ መሆኑ ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, miidhaan guddaan buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Erbil, Iraaq irratti gaheera jedhan. Iraan yoo waraanni kun itti fufe duula waraanaa babal'isuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Kaayyoon isaanis Ameerikaan dhiibbaa waraanaatiin Iraan irratti fedhii ishee akka hin feene hubachiisuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Official says Trump's preference ' is diplomacy' as US pauses Iran strikes
english: The United States has paused its recent series of military strikes against Iran, with officials stating that President Trump still favors diplomatic solutions while remaining ready to use force if necessary. Meanwhile, tensions have risen between Iran and Ukraine following an explosion on an Iranian commercial ship in the Caspian Sea. Although the US strikes have temporarily ceased, the American naval blockade in the region continues.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ስትወስድ የነበረውን ተከታታይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ለጊዜው አቁማለች። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ቅድሚያ የሚሰጡት ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን ድርድር ካልጀመረች አስፈላጊውን እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ በኢራን የንግድ መርከብ ላይ በደረሰ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት በኢራን እና በዩክሬን መካከል ውጥረት ተፈጥሯል። የአሜሪካ የባህር ሃይል ማገጃ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa tarkaanfii waraanaa Iran irratti fudhachaa turte yeroof kan dhaabde yoo ta'u, mootummaan Ameerikaa marii fi diploomaasiin furmaata argachuun akka isaanii dursee filatamu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, Iran mariitti dhuphachuu baannaan tarkaanfii irra deebi'anii fudhachuuf akka qophiin jiru ibsameera. Gammachuu sanaan ala, markabii daldalaa Iran kan galaana Kaaspiyanitti dhuka'e irratti walitti bu'iinsa Iran fi Yukreen gidduutti uumameera. Hanqisni galaanaa kan Ameerikaa ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Centcom says Iran naval blockade remains in full effect, 12 ships redirected
english: The U.S. military is maintaining a strict naval blockade around Iran, resulting in the redirection of 12 commercial ships that attempted to enter Iranian ports. To enforce these restrictions, American forces disabled two vessels and boarded two others for verification purposes after they failed to comply with warnings. Operations remain active as the U.S. continues to monitor and control maritime traffic in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአይራን ላይ የጣለውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ አጠናክሮ የቀጠለ ሲሆን ወደ አይራን ወደቦች ለመግባት የሞከሩ 12 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ እንዲቀይሩ አድርጓል። ደንቡን ለማስከበር የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ሁለት መርከቦችን ማቆምና ሁለት መርከቦችን ደግሞ አስጠንቅቆ መፈተሽ ችሏል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ዕዝ ክልሉን በቅርበት መከታተሉን እና እገዳውን የማስፈጸም ስራውን እንደቀጠለበት አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa daangaa galaanaatiin Iran irratti godhan harka galchiin cimaa itti fufanii jiru. Kana keessatti, dooniiwwan daldalaa 12 gara buufataalee Iran seenuuf yaalan karaa irraa akka maqan godhaniiru. Seericha kabachiisuuf, humnoonni Ameerikaa dooniiwwan lama miidhuun akkasumas kanneen biroo lama immoo xiinxaluun dirqama isaanii akka raawwatan godhaniiru; hojiiwwan kunneenis naannichatti to’annoo cimaa godhuuf itti fufaniiru.

title: One dead, 14 injured as car reportedly strikes crowd at Berlin LGBTQ event
english: A tragic incident occurred in Berlin when a car drove into a crowd at a major LGBTQ Pride parade, resulting in one death and at least 14 injuries. Authorities immediately canceled the event and evacuated the area as they launched a search for the individuals who abandoned the vehicle. Emergency teams are providing care to the victims, some of whom remain in critical condition.
amharic: በርሊን ውስጥ በተካሄደው የኤልጂቢቲኪው (LGBTQ) ሰልፍ ላይ መኪና በህዝብ ላይ በመውጣቱ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ፖሊስ ክብረ በዓሉን በማቋረጥ አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ለተሳታፊዎች አሳስቧል። መኪናውን ትተው የሄዱትን ተጠርጣሪዎች ለማግኘት የአካባቢው ደህንነት ሃይሎች ከፍተኛ ፍለጋ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: በርሊንitti ayyaana kabaja mirga saalaa (LGBTQ) irratti konkolaataan namoota baay'ee biratti oofamee namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni 14 ol ta'an miidhaniiru. Polisiin ajjeechaa kana hordofee ayyaanichi akka dhaabatu godhee, namoonni bakka sanaa akka ba'an ajajeera. Konkolaataa achitti dhiisanii badaniifis poolisiin barbaacha cimaa geggeessaa jira.

title: Several injured at Berlin Pride after reports vehicle drove into crowd, police say
english: Several people were injured during a Berlin Pride event after a vehicle reportedly drove into a crowd near Tiergarten park. Authorities have launched a large-scale manhunt for the perpetrator and have officially cancelled the remainder of the celebrations. Emergency responders are currently treating the victims at the scene while police advise the public to stay away from the area.
amharic: በበርሊን የኩራት በዓል (Pride) ዝግጅት ወቅት አንድ ተሽከርካሪ ወደ ህዝብ መግባቱን ተከትሎ በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ተጠርጣሪውን ለመያዝ ከፍተኛ ፍለጋ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የቀረው የክብረ በዓሉ መርሃ ግብር መሰረዙን አስታውቋል። ድንገተኛ አደጋ ተከላካዮች በቦታው ተገኝተው ለተጎጂዎች ህክምና እየሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ህዝቡ አካባቢውን እንዲራቅ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Ayyaana 'Berlin Pride' irratti konkolaataan tokko namoota hedduu irratti qajeelfamee bu'uun namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Poolisiin namicha kana qabuuf hordoffii cimaa taasisaa jiru yoo ta'u, ayyaanichi guutummaatti dhaabbachuu isaas beeksiseera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa miidhamtoota iddoo sanatti wal'aanaa jiran, akkasumas uummanni naannichaa akka irraa fagaatu akeekkachiifameera.

title: Israeli forces target Gaza’s Al-Aqsa hospital
english: Israeli military drones carried out an attack on a group of Palestinians located near the Al-Aqsa Hospital in Gaza. This strike resulted in the death of at least one individual and left several others wounded. The incident occurred in the vicinity of the medical facility, raising concerns about the safety of people near healthcare sites.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድሮኖች በጋዛ በሚገኘው አል-አቅሳ ሆስፒታል አቅራቢያ በተሰበሰቡ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሌሎች በርካቶች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው የህክምና ተቋሙ አቅራቢያ በመሆኑ በሆስፒታሉ አካባቢ ባሉ ሰዎች ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa’el gaazaatti hospitaala Al-Aqsa biratti garee Falasxiinotaa irratti miilaan boombii buusan raawwataniiru. Hojii waraana kanaatiin lubbuun namoota tokkoo yoo darbu, kan biroon immoo hedduun isaanii madaa'aniiru. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame bakka buufata fayyaa kanaatti dhihoo waan ta'eef, namoota hospitaalicha keessaa fi naannawa isaa jiran irratti sodaa uumeera.

title: What’s next for Venezuela’s path to recovery from devastating earthquakes?
english: Venezuela is currently struggling to recover after two powerful earthquakes caused thousands of deaths and widespread destruction last month. With tens of thousands of homes damaged and many citizens still missing, the nation faces a massive reconstruction project costing billions of dollars. Authorities have transitioned from rescue operations to recovery, but the country faces significant challenges in securing the necessary funding and support for long-term rebuilding.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ ባለፈው ወር በደረሱ ሁለት ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል፤ ከፍተኛ የንብረት ውድመትም ደርሷል። በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመፍረሳቸው እና ብዙ ሰዎች እስካሁን የት እንዳሉ ባለመታወቁ፣ ሀገሪቱ በቢሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ዶላር የሚጠይቅ ግዙፍ የመልሶ ግንባታ ስራ ይጠብቃታል። መንግስት የነፍስ አድን ስራውን ወደ መልሶ ማቋቋም ቢቀይርም፣ ለዚህ መጠነ ሰፊ ስራ የሚያስፈልገውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Venazuweelaa keessatti ji'a darbe sochiin lafaa humna guddaa qabu lama mudatee lubbuu namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman galaafatee jira. Mana jireenyaa kumaatamaan lakkaawaman barbadaa'anii fi namoonni hedduun ammoo bakka buutee isaanii dhabuun, biyyattiin hojii ijaarsa deebii kan biliyoona hedduun tilmaamamu keessa jirti. Mootummaan hojii furmaata ariifachiisaa irraa gara deebisanii ijaaruutti ce'us, deeggarsa maallaqaa barbaachisu argachuun rakkisaa ta'ee jira.

title: Israeli forces tear gas journalists reporting Nablus shootout
english: Israeli forces used tear gas against journalists and local residents in the village of Tal. This incident occurred shortly after a violent clash resulted in the deaths of four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers. Tensions remain high in the area as locals fear further attacks following reports of property damage caused by Israeli settlers.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በታል መንደር ውስጥ በጋዜጠኞችና በነዋሪዎች ላይ እንባ አፋሽ ጋዝ ተጠቅመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው አራት ፍልስጤማውያንና ሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተገደሉበት ግጭት ማግስት ነው። በአካባቢው ያሉ ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ንብረት ላይ በደረሰው ጉዳት ምክንያት ተጨማሪ ጥቃት ይፈጸምብናል የሚል ስጋት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el ganda Tal jedhamu keessatti gaazexeessitootaafi jiraattota irratti gaazii imimmaan dhangalaasu fayyadameera. Mudannoon kun erga walitti bu'iinsa cimaa namoota shan hedduu ajjeese booda guyyaa itti aanutti kan raawwatameedha. Jiraattonni naannichaa qabeenyi isaanii qonnaan bultoota Israa'elidhaan gubachuu hordofee, miidhaan biraa ni ga'a jedhanii sodachaa jiru.

title: How India’s ‘Cockroach’ protesters shook the Modi government
english: India's Education Minister recently resigned following over a month of persistent protests led by young activists known as the Cockroach Janta Party. What started as a satirical movement evolved into a significant national outcry triggered by major exam paper scandals. This sustained public pressure successfully forced a high-level government change.
amharic: የህንድ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ከወር በላይ በዘለቀው የወጣቶች ተቃውሞ ሳቢያ ከስልጣናቸው ለቀዋል። በኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ የሚመራው ይህ የተቃውሞ ንቅናቄ፣ በፈተና ወረቀት መፍሰስ ቅሌት የተነሳ በመላ ሀገሪቱ ተቀጣጥሎ ነበር። በአስቂኝ መልክ የተጀመረው ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የህንድ መንግስትን በመገዳደር ከፍተኛ ለውጥ አስገኝቷል።
oromo: Ministirri barnoota Hindii dargaggoota 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamaniin gaggeeffamaa turee fi guyyoota soddomii ja'a ol turee booda hojii gadhiiseera. Sochiin kun jalqabarratti qophii taphaa fakkaatuun kan eegalame ta'us, rakkoo qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti mudateen walqabatee gara mormii cimaa biyyoolessaatti guddate. Dhiibbaan dargaggootaa kun dhumarratti mootummaan Hindii jijjiirama olaanaa akka taasisu dirqisiiseera.

title: Head of Hamas-led police in northern Gaza killed by Israeli strike
english: The commander of the Hamas-led police in northern Gaza, Brigadier-General Abdel-Nasser Al-Maqadma, was killed during an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City. This incident was part of a broader series of strikes that resulted in the deaths of five other Palestinians, including a medic and a student. Hamas officials claim these operations are an intentional attempt by Israel to undermine regional stability, while the Israeli military maintains that the police force is connected to militant groups.
amharic: በሰሜን ጋዛ የሃማስ የፖሊስ ሃላፊ የነበሩት ብርጋዴር ጄኔራል አብደል-ናሰር አል-ማቃድማ በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መገደላቸው ተገለጸ። ይህ ጥቃት ሌሎች አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ከተገደሉባቸው ተከታታይ የጦር እርምጃዎች አንዱ ነው። ሃማስ እስራኤል የጋዛን አካባቢ ለማተራመስ የፖሊስ ሰራተኞችን ሆን ብላ እያጠቃች ነው ሲል ሲከስ፣ እስራኤል በበኩሏ የፖሊስ አባላቱ ከታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የሚል አቋም አላት።
oromo: Ajajaan poolisii Hamas kan Kaaba Gaaza, Biraagadeer Jeneraal Abdal-Naasir Al-Maqadmaa, rukuttaa qilleensaarraa Israa'el iddoo Gaazaasitti gaggeessiteen ajjeefameera. Gochi kun namoota biroo shan ajjeesise yoo ta'u, isaan keessa ogeessa fayyaa fi barataa tokko akka jiran himameera. Hamas, Israa'el nageenya naannichaa booressuuf jecha humna poolisii kana akka kaayyoo ishee godhatte dubbata; gama biraatiin, waraanni Israa'el humnoonni poolisii kun garee hidhattootaa waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu jechuun isaan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu ibseera.

title: At least 35 killed after two buses collide in eastern Syria
english: A tragic head-on collision between two buses on a highway in eastern Syria has resulted in the deaths of at least 35 people. Many others sustained injuries in the crash, which occurred on a primary road connecting the region to Damascus. This incident highlights ongoing worries regarding dangerous road conditions and the poor state of transportation infrastructure in the war-torn country.
amharic: በምስራቅ ሶሪያ በሁለት አውቶቡሶች መካከል በተፈጠረ የትራፊክ አደጋ ቢያንስ 35 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው ምስራቅ ሶሪያን ከደማስቆ ጋር በሚያገናኘው ዋና መንገድ ላይ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አደጋ ለረጅም ጊዜ በዘለቀው ጦርነት ሳቢያ የተበላሹ የመንገድ መሰረተ ልማቶች እና ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቁ መንገዶች አለመኖር የሚያስከትለውን ስጋት ጎላ አድርጎ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Siriyaa bahaatti konkolaatawwan fe'umsaa lama walitti bu'uu isaaniitiin lubbuun namoota 35 ol darbeera. Balaan kun karaa guddaa baha Siriyaan magaalaa Damaasqoo waliin wal qunnamsiisu irratti kan mudate yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun yeroo dheeraaf lola keessa turuun bu'uuraalee misoomaa daandii manca'uu fi rakkoo nageenya daandii biyyattii keessatti bal'inaan jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Ebola deaths in DRC surge past 1,300 as virus ‘spreading like a wildfire’
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a critical stage, with deaths exceeding 1,300 amid an alarming increase in infection rates. This specific variant is difficult to manage because it currently lacks any approved vaccines or medical treatments. Compounding the crisis, the virus is circulating in a conflict-ridden region, though scientists have recently begun clinical trials for a new experimental vaccine.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ1,300 በላይ በመድረሱ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። ይህ የቫይረሱ ዝርያ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት የተረጋገጠ ክትባት ወይም ህክምና ስለሌለው ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። ወረርሽኙ በተቀሰቀሰባቸው አካባቢዎች ያለው ግጭት ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አወሳስቦት ቢቆይም፣ ሳይንቲስቶች አዲስ የሙከራ ክትባት ላይ ስራ መጀመራቸው ተነግሯል።
oromo: Dhukkubni Ebola biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'ate du'a namoota 1,300 ol fiduun sadarkaa yaaddessaa irra ga'eera. Vaayirasin kun kan addaa fi yeroo ammaa qoricha ykn talaallii itti beekamu waan hin qabneef to'achuun ulfaataa ta'eera. Rakkoon waraanaa naannoo sana jiru dhibee kana caalaatti hammaachiiseera, ta'us saayintistoonni talaallii haaraa qorannoo irratti argamu tokko yaaluu jalqabaniiru.

title: How Netanyahu gov’t media reforms risk deepening Israeli press bias
english: The Israeli government has passed controversial media reforms that grant authorities more control over news outlets and remove existing journalism standards and ownership regulations. Critics and opposition groups argue these changes threaten press freedom and could unfairly influence upcoming elections by allowing greater government bias. The High Court of Justice has temporarily frozen parts of the legislation while it reviews legal challenges from journalists and political opponents.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በመገናኛ ብዙሃን ላይ ያደረገው አወዛጋቢ ማሻሻያ በዜና አውታሮች ላይ የመንግስት ቁጥጥርን እንዲጨምር እና የጋዜጠኝነት ደረጃዎችን እንዲቀንስ የሚያደርግ ነው። ተቺዎች ይህ እርምጃ የመገናኛ ብዙሃንን ነፃነት እንደሚገድብ እና ከመጪው ምርጫ በፊት ለገዢው ፓርቲ አድልዎ በመፍጠር ምርጫውን እንደሚነካ ያሰጋሉ። የሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የጋዜጠኞች እና የተቃዋሚዎች አቤቱታ ተቀብሎ የተወሰኑ የህጉ ክፍሎችን በጊዜያዊነት አግዷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el jijjiirama miidiyaa fudhate kan mormi guddaan irratti ka'e yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaan oduu irratti dhiibbaa akka godhuufi qajeelfamoota gaazexeessummaa akka laaffisuuf karaa bana. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkiinni kun bilisummaa miidiyaa kan miidhuufi filannoo dhufullee irratti dhiibbaa gochuun mootummaan akka faayidaa argatu godha. Mana murtii olaanaa Israa'el himata gaazexeessitootaa fi mormitoonni dhiyeessan ilaaluun, seera kana keessaa kutaa tokko yeroof akka turu murteesseera.

title: Why Epstein’s survivors are still fighting
english: Years after Jeffrey Epstein's death, survivors of his abuse continue to seek justice and accountability. They are currently organizing to oppose Donald Trump's choice for attorney general, fearing his influence. This ongoing effort highlights their determination to keep the case in the public eye despite the powerful political figures involved.
amharic: ጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ከሞተ ዓመታት ያስቆጠረ ቢሆንም፣ በደል የደረሰባቸው ሴቶች ለፍትህ እና ለተጠያቂነት መታገላቸውን ቀጥለዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግ ዕጩ በመሆናቸው ስጋት በመግባት፣ ሹመቱን ለመቃወም እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ጉዳዩ በፖለቲካዊ ተፅዕኖዎች ሳይሸፈን የህዝብ ትኩረት እንዲያገኝ ለማድረግ ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Jeefrii Epistayin erga du’ee waggoonni hedduun darbanis, warri miidhaan irra ga’e haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaa argachuuf qabsaawuusaanii itti fufaniiru. Amma immoo, namni Donaald Tiraamp muuduu barbaadan sun aangoo qabachuun isaa dhiibbaa akka fidu waan sodaataniif, muudama sana mormuuf walitti qophaa’aa jiru. Qabsoon kun, miidhaan irra ga’e kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa jiru hunda osoo hin sodaatin, rakkoon kun akka hin irraanfatamne fi haqni akka argamuuf murannoo qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: India's 'cockroach' protest called off after education minister quits
english: A satirical protest movement known as the Cockroach Janta Party has ended its five-week demonstration in India following the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. The online-led group, which voiced the concerns of young people, celebrated the minister's departure as a significant victory for democratic expression. Pradhan stepped down citing a desire to protect student futures and maintain national unity amidst growing public unrest.
amharic: በህንድ 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' የተሰኘው የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴ የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ ዳርሜንድራ ፕራዳን ከስልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ለሳምንታት ሲያካሂዱት የነበረውን ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አቁመዋል። በኢንተርኔት አማካይነት የተደራጀው ይህ ቡድን፣ የወጣቶችን ቅሬታ በማሰማት ሚኒስትሩ እንዲለቁ በማድረጉ ድል እንደቀናቸው ገልጸዋል። ሚኒስትሩ በበኩላቸው፣ የተማሪዎችን የትምህርት እድል ለመጠበቅ እና በአገሪቱ የተፈጠረውን አለመረጋጋት ለመቀነስ በሚል ስልጣናቸውን በገዛ ፈቃዳቸው መልቀቃቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mormiin 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu kan Indiyaa keessatti torban shanf dura eegale, Ministirri Barnootaa Dharmendra Pradhan gadi bu'uu isaanii hordofee dhaabateera. Gareen interneetii fayyadamee walitti dhufe kun, rakkoo dargaggootaa dubbachuun isaanii fi jijjiirama dhufuun isaa akka injifannoo demokraasii guddaatti fudhatameera. Ministirri Pradhan, egereen barattootaa akka hin miidhamne fi tokkummaan biyyattii akka eegamuuf jecha aangoo gadhiisuu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: More than 250,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain
english: Over 250,000 people have been forced to leave their homes in France and Spain due to massive wildfires worsened by extreme heat and high winds. Authorities are struggling to contain the blazes, which have already caused at least one fatality in Spain and prompted military intervention in France. While conditions have slightly improved in some parts of Spain, residents in southwestern France remain in danger as fires move toward Bordeaux.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ እና በስፔን በተከሰቱ ከፍተኛ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ሳቢያ ከ250,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። በከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና በኃይለኛ ንፋስ የታገዘው ይህ አደጋ በስፔን የሰው ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን፣ በፈረንሳይ ደግሞ የጦር ኃይሉን ለማገዝ እንዲሰማራ አድርጓል። የስፔን አንዳንድ አካባቢዎች መሻሻል ቢታይባቸውም፣ በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ቡድኖች እሳቱ ወደ ቦርዶ ከተማ እንዳይደርስ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Faransaay fi Ispeen keessatti ibidda bosonaa cimaa mudateen kan ka'e namoonni kuma 250 ol ta'an manasaanii gadhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Balaan kun oowwaa cimaa fi qilleensa humna qabuun kan boba'aa jiru yoo ta'u, Ispeen keessatti lubbuun namtokkee darbeera, Faransaay keessatti immoo waraanni gargaarsaaf bobba'eera. Bakka tokko tokkotti haalli qilleensaa fooyya'us, Faransaay keessatti ibiddisi gara magaalaa Bordooitti siqaa waan jiruuf namoonni soda keessa jiru.

title: Iran’s government spars with state TV as mediators push talks with US
english: A conflict has broken out between the Iranian government and the state-run broadcaster over the censorship of recent high-level speeches. The government accused the media outlet of cutting footage related to President Pezeshkian’s comments about secret negotiations with the United States. In response, the broadcaster defended its actions, arguing it must prevent any public perception of division within the nation's leadership.
amharic: በኢራን መንግስት እና በመንግስት የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ መካከል በቅርብ ጊዜ በተደረጉ ንግግሮች ሳንሱር ዙሪያ አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። መንግስት የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያው ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር ስለሚደረጉ ድብቅ ድርድሮች ፕሬዝዳንት ፔዜሽኪያን የተናገሩትን ክፍል በመቁረጡ ከሰዋል። የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያው በበኩሉ በአገሪቱ አመራሮች መካከል ልዩነት እንዳለ የሚያሳይ ምስል እንዳይፈጠር ለመከላከል እርምጃው አስፈላጊ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ውንጀላውን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Mootummaa Iraanii fi miidiyaan biyyattii gidduutti wal dhabdee uumamee jira. Mootummaan miidiyaan kun haasawa Prezidaant Pezeeshkiyaan kan waa'ee marii iccitii kan Ameerikaa waliin godhamaa jiru ibsu kutuun isaa 'sansoorii' dha jedhee komateera. Miidiyaan kun gamasaatiin, dhimmi kun hoggansa biyyattii gidduutti wal dhabdee akka jiru fakkeessuu waan danda'uuf, kana ittisuuf jecha akka kutame ibseera.

title: Worker dies during reconstruction of Barcelona’s Camp Nou Stadium
english: A 54-year-old construction worker has died following a fatal head injury while working at Barcelona’s Camp Nou stadium. The football club expressed deep regret and offered condolences regarding the workplace accident that occurred during the ongoing renovations. The stadium has been undergoing a massive reconstruction project since 2023 to expand its capacity to 105,000 seats.
amharic: በባርሴሎና የካምፕ ኑ ስታዲየም እድሳት ላይ ተሰማርተው የነበሩ የ54 ዓመት የኮንስትራክሽን ሠራተኛ በደረሰባቸው አደጋ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ክለቡ ባወጣው መግለጫ በሠራተኛው ህልፈት የተሰማውን ጥልቅ ሐዘን በመግለጽ ለቤተሰቦቹ መጽናናትን ተመኝቷል። ስታዲየሙ አቅሙን ወደ 105,000 መቀመጫዎች ለማሳደግ ከ2015 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ሰፊ የማስፋፊያ ሥራ እየተከናወነበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Hojjetaan ijaarsa istaadiyeemii Kaamp Noo kan Baarseloonaa irratti hojjetaa ture kan umriin isaa 54 ta’e, balaa bakka hojiitti isa mudateen du’eera. Kilabichi gadda guddaa itti dhaga’ame ibsuun maatii fi hiriyoota hojjetaa sanaaf jajjabina hawwaniiru. Istaadiyeemichi kun qabeenya isaa gara iddoo namoota 105,000 qabachuu danda’utti guddisuuf hojiin ijaarsaa bara 2023 irraa eegalee itti fufaa jira.

title: 'We want to see blood': Israeli political leadership and settler groups call for revenge against Palestinians
english: Israeli political leaders and settler groups are publicly demanding violent retribution and the destruction of Palestinian villages in the West Bank. These calls for vengeance followed a deadly incident where four members of a Palestinian family and an Israeli settler were killed. Government officials have suggested turning these communities into ruins, prompting widespread concerns regarding the escalation of settler violence in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል የፖለቲካ መሪዎች እና የሰፈራ ቡድኖች በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን መንደሮች ላይ የበቀል እርምጃ እና ጥፋት እንዲደርስ በይፋ እየጠየቁ ነው። እነዚህ የቁጣ ጥሪዎች የተሰሙት የአራት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰብ አባላት እና አንድ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪ ህይወት ካለፈበት ግጭት በኋላ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን መንደሮች ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማውደም እና ነዋሪዎቻቸውን ለማፈናቀል ሃሳብ ያቀረቡ ሲሆን ይህም በክልሉ ያለውን የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ስጋት ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni siyaasaa Israa'el fi gareewwan qubattootaa lafa daangaa dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti gandoota Falastinuu irratti haaloo bahuu fi mancaatii akka geessisan ifatti gaafachaa jiru. Waamichi haaloo bahuu kun kan uumame maatii Falastinuu tokko keessaa namoonni afur fi qubattee Israa'el tokko ajjeefamuu isaanii hordofee dha. Hojjettoonni mootummaa gandoota kana mancaasuu fi jiraattota isaa buqqisuuf yaada dhiyeessaniiru; kunis naannichatti jeequmsi qubattootaa akka hammatu sodaa uumee jira.

title: What next for the ICC and the Palestine investigation after Karim Khan's removal?
english: The International Criminal Court has voted to remove Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan following allegations of misconduct, marking the first such dismissal in the court's history. While Israel has welcomed the decision and requested that arrest warrants for its officials be dropped, Khan maintains his innocence and plans to legally challenge the ruling. The future of the ongoing investigation into Palestine remains uncertain as the court transitions to new leadership.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ከሪም ካን በፈጸሙት ተብሎ በሚነገር ጥሰት ምክንያት ከአላፊነታቸው እንዲነሱ በድምፅ ብልጫ ወስኗል። እስራኤል የዚህን ውሳኔ መነሳት በደስታ የተቀበለች ሲሆን በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የወጡት የእስር ማዘዣዎች እንዲሰረዙ ጠይቃለች። ከሪም ካን ግን ጥፋተኛ እንዳልሆኑ በመግለጽ የፍርድ ቤቱን ውሳኔ በህግ ለመቃወም አቅደዋል። ይህም የፍልስጤምን የምርመራ ሂደት የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ አጠያያቂ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaatti (ICC) himata yakkaa raawwataniiru jedhamanii himatamuun qajeelchaan himataa Karim Khaan hojii irraa akka gaggeeffaman sagaleen irratti kennamee jira. Israa'el murtee kana kan simatte yoo ta'u, ajajni qabamuu hoogganoota ishee irratti darbe akka haqamu gaafatteetti. Karim Khaan yakka raawwachuu isaanii haaluun murtee kana mana murtii biraatti falmachuuf karoorfataniiru; kunis qorannoo Falasxiin irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu gaaffii keessa galcheera.

title: Palestinian death toll in Khan Younis reaches three
english: Israeli military operations in Khan Younis resulted in the deaths of at least three Palestinians on Saturday. Two victims died following an airstrike on a residential building, while another individual was killed during a drone strike in the al-Mawasi district. Across the entire Gaza Strip, medical authorities report that daily violence has left six people dead and more than twenty others injured.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በካን ዩኒስ ቢያንስ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ሁለት ሰዎች የአየር ጥቃት በደረሰባቸው መኖሪያ ቤት ሲሞቱ፣ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በአል-ማዋሲ አካባቢ በድሮን ጥቃት ተገድሏል። በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በአጠቃላይ ስድስት ሰዎች መሞታቸውና ከሃያ በላይ የሚሆኑት መቁሰላቸውን የህክምና ምንጮች አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Khan Younis keessatti weerara Israa'el gaggeesseen palastineewwan yoo xiqqaate saddeeti ajjeefamaniiru. Namoonni lama mana jireenyaa tokko irratti xiyyaarri erga haleelee booda du'an; tokko immoo naannoo al-Mawasiitti weerara 'drone'tiin ajjeefame. Gabaasni hospitaala irraa argame akka agarsiisutti, har'a guyyaa guutuu Gazaar keessatti weerara Israa'el kanaan namoonni jaha du'anii, namoonni dhibbaan lakkawaman immoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli air strike on family home
english: At least two Palestinians were killed following an Israeli aerial attack on a residence in Khan Younis. The strike targeted a family home, resulting in fatalities according to recent reports. Further details regarding the circumstances of the incident have not been disclosed.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በአንድ ቤተሰብ መኖሪያ ላይ እንደሆነ የተገለጸ ሲሆን የሟቾችን ቁጥርም አረጋግጧል። ስለ ጉዳዩ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች እስካሁን አልተገለፁም።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Kaani Yuunis keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwateen namoonni Falasxiin lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan qajeelfame mana maatii tokko irratti ta'uun gabaasameera. Haala raawwii haleellaa kanaa ilaalchisee odeeffannoon dabalataa waan hin kennamneef, gabaasichi ajjechaa kana qofa ibsa.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a deeply ingrained social culture that prioritizes blind obedience over constructive dialogue. From households to classrooms and professional workplaces, individuals are conditioned to view questioning authority as an act of disloyalty. This systemic pattern discourages critical thinking and reinforces hierarchical power structures, which ultimately hinders the country's progress toward a more democratic society.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ተግዳሮቶች መነሻው ለስልጣን ባለው አመለካከት ላይ የተመሰረተ ጥልቅ ማህበራዊ ባህል ነው። ከቤተሰብ እስከ ትምህርት ቤት እና የስራ ቦታዎች ድረስ፣ ሰዎችን ለባለስልጣናት ወይም ለአለቆች ጥያቄ ማቅረብ እንደ አለመታዘዝ የሚቆጠርበት አሰራር ተስፋፍቷል። ይህ አሳታፊ ያልሆነና የሃይል ተዋረድን ብቻ የሚያጠናክር አስተሳሰብ ለዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት ግንባታ ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Rakkoon dimokiraasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu, aadaa hawaasaa aangoo fi aboo fudhachuu wajjin wal qabatee jiru irraa maddatti. Maatii irraa eegalee hanga mana barumsaafi bakka hojiitti, namoonni aangoo irratti gaaffii kaasuu akka gantummaatti akka ilaalan ta'aniiru. Adeemsi kun yaada bilisaa fi marii dhorkuun, caasumaa aangoo cimaa irratti waan hundaa'uuf, biyyattiin gara sirna dimokiraasii dhugaatti akka hin ceene gufuu ta'eera.

title: India win second T20 in Zimbabwe to take series as Kishan and Varma shine
english: India secured a T20 series victory over Zimbabwe by winning the second match in Harare by 90 runs. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the scoring, helping India set a challenging target of 219. Zimbabwe struggled to chase the total and were bowled out for 129, giving India an unbeatable 2-0 lead in the three-game series.
amharic: ሕንድ በሀራሬ በተካሄደው ሁለተኛው የቲ-20 የክሪኬት ጨዋታ ዚምባብዌን በ90 ሩጫ በማሸነፍ ተከታታይ ድል አስመዝግባለች። ኢሻን ኪሻን እና ቲላክ ቫርማ ባሳዩት ድንቅ ብቃት ህንድ 219 ሩጫዎችን ማስመዝገብ ችላለች። የዚምባብዌ ቡድን ግቡን ለማሳካት ተቸግሮ በ129 ሩጫ በመውጣቱ ህንድ የሶስት ጨዋታዎች ተከታታይ ድሉን 2 ለ 0 በሆነ ውጤት አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Indiyaa tapha kiriketi T20 lammaffaa Haraaree keessatti gaggeeffame irratti Ziimbaabuwee 90n mo'achuun injifannoo walitti aansuudhaan fudhatteetti. Ishaan Kiishaan fi Tiilaak Vaarmaa qabxii gaarii galchuudhaan Indiyaan 219 akka galchitu gargaaraniiru. Ziimbaabuween qabxii kana galchuuf yaaltus, 129 qofa galchuun taphichi erga xumuramee booda Indiyaan 2-0n leencuu dandeesseetti.

title: ‘We have done it’: Joy as ‘Cockroach’ protests push India minister out
english: India's Education Minister, Dharmendra Pradhan, has resigned following 36 days of intense youth-led protests triggered by widespread exam paper leaks. The movement was spearheaded by the 'Cockroach Janta Party,' a satirical group formed after officials disparaged young protesters. With their primary demands met, including government accountability and support for affected families, the demonstrators have successfully concluded their campaign.
amharic: የህንድ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ድሃርሜንድራ ፕራድሃን በፈተና ወረቀት መፍሰስ ቅሌት ሳቢያ በተነሱ የ36 ቀናት የተማሪዎች ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው ለቀቁ። ተቃውሞውን የመሩት ወጣቶች በባለስልጣናት 'ጠረንቋና ጥገኛ' ተብለው መጠራታቸውን ተከትሎ 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' የተሰኘ አስቂኝ እንቅስቃሴ በመፍጠር ነበር። መንግስት የካሳ ክፍያ እና ይቅርታን ጨምሮ ሁሉንም የጠያቂዎቹን ጥያቄዎች በመቀበሉ ተቃዋሚዎቹ እንቅስቃሴያቸውን በድል አጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri barnoota Indiyaa Dharmendra Pradhan, qormaata biyyaalessaa ilaalchisee rakkoo mudateen walqabatee guyyoota 36f hiriira cimaa dargaggootaa booda aangoo gadhiiseera. Dargaggoonni kun 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhu hundeessee, aanga'oonni akka 'ilbiisaatti' waan isaan salphisanif mormii isaanitti fayyadamuun sagalee isaanii dhageessisaniiru. Mootummaan fedhii hiriirtootaa guutuun gumaa maatiif kennuufi dhiifama gaafachuu hordofee, hiriirtoonni injifannoon guyyaa har'aa mormii isaanii xumuraniiru.

title: Syrian FM calls for Israeli withdrawal in meeting with UN chief
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani met with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in Damascus to formally demand that Israel pull its forces out of southern Syria without conditions. During the visit, the UN chief also held discussions with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. The meeting highlights ongoing diplomatic efforts regarding the status of the southern Syrian region.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሳድ አል-ሻይባኒ በደማስቆ ከተማ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ፀሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝን አግኝተዋል። በውይይቱ ወቅት እስራኤል ያለምንም ቅድመ ሁኔታ ከደቡብ ሶሪያ ወታደሮቿን እንድታስወጣ ጠይቀዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ፀሐፊ በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ከሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ጋርም ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Sooriyaa Asaad al-Shaibani magaalaa Damaasqoo keessatti Qondaala olaanaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guterres waliin wal arguun isaanii gabaafameera. Ministirichi mootummaan Israa'el loltoota ishee naannoo kibba Sooriyaa irraa haala tokko malee akka baastu gaafataniiru. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaan, Guterres pirezidaantii Sooriyaa Ahimad al-Sharaa waliinis mari'ataniiru.

title: The Battle Over Al-Aqsa
english: A large group of Israelis recently entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound accompanied by security forces. The visit was led by National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, sparking significant tension. This event has drawn widespread attention due to the sensitive nature of the site and its importance to the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በርካታ እስራኤላውያን በጸጥታ ኃይሎች ታጅበው ወደ አል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ መግባታቸው አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ጉብኝቱን የመሩት የእስራኤል ብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር ናቸው። ይህ ድርጊት በስፍራው ያለውን ስሜታዊ ሁኔታ በመቀስቀስ ውጥረትን አባብሷል።
oromo: Humni Israa'eelotaa hedduun poolisootaan eegamaa gara dirree Masjiida Al-Aqsa seenanii jiru. Daawwannaa kana kan hogganan ministirri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'eel Itaamaar Ben-Gviiri dha. Gochi kun bakki kun iddoo rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jiru ta'uun isaa fi haala walxaxaa jiruun walqabatee mormii guddaa kaasee jira.

title: The Global South is being forced to choose creditors over children
english: Many developing nations are currently spending far more on repaying external debts than on providing education for their citizens. This global financial structure forces governments to prioritize payments to international creditors over essential funding for schools and students. As a result, millions of children face declining school quality and limited access to education while wealth flows out of poor nations toward wealthy financial institutions.
amharic: በርካታ ታዳጊ ሀገራት ለውጭ ዕዳ ክፍያ ከሚውለው ገንዘብ ይልቅ ለዜጎቻቸው ትምህርት የሚያውሉት በጣም አነስተኛ ነው። አሁን ያለው ዓለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት መንግስታት ለትምህርት ቤት ግንባታ እና ለተማሪዎች አገልግሎት ከሚሰጡት በጀት ይልቅ ለዓለም አቀፍ አበዳሪዎች ክፍያ ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ ያስገድዳቸዋል። በውጤቱም፣ ከፍተኛ የሀብት ፍሰት ከድሃ ሀገራት ወደ ሀብታም የፋይናንስ ተቋማት ስለሚሄድ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት ጥራት ያለው ትምህርት የማግኘት እድላቸው እየተመናመነ ነው።
oromo: Biyoonni guddachaa jiran baay'een isaanii kaffaltii liqii alaa irratti baasii hedduu waan godhaniif, barnoota lammiilee isaaniif gahaa ta'e dhiyeessuu hin dandeenye. Sirni faayinaansii addunyaa ammaa kun mootummoonni maallaqa mana barumsaa fi barattootaaf oolu qaban duraan dursee liqii kaffaluuf akka oolchan dirqisiisa. Kunis sababa ta'ee biyyoota hiyyeeyyiirraa gara dhaabbilee faayinaansii sooressotaatti qabeenyi waan yaa'uuf, ijoolleen miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman barnoota gaarii argachuu dhabanii jiru.

title: Atletico Madrid sign South Korea World Cup star Lee Kang-In from PSG
english: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-In has officially transferred from Paris Saint-Germain to Atletico Madrid on a contract lasting until 2031. The 25-year-old playmaker joins the Spanish team for an estimated fee of 35 to 40 million euros. He is expected to play a key creative role for the club following the departure of Antoine Griezmann.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያው አማካይ ሊ ካንግ-ኢን ከፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን ወደ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ እስከ 2031 ዓ.ም የሚቆይ ውል ተፈራርሟል። የ25 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ወደ ስፔኑ ክለብ የተቀላቀለው ከ35 እስከ 40 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በሚገመት የዝውውር ሂሳብ ነው። አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ የአንቷን ግሪዝማንን መውጣት ተከትሎ የተፈጠረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት በሊ ካንግ-ኢን የፈጠራ ችሎታ ላይ ትልቅ እምነት ጥሏል።
oromo: Giddu-galeessaan Kooriyaa Kibbaa Lee Kang-In Paris Saint-Germain gadhiisee gara Atletico Madrid kan ce'e yommuu ta'u, hanga bara 2031tti kan turu waliigaltee mallatteesseera. Taphataan umriin isaa 25 ta'e kun gara kilabii Ispeen kanatti kan makame qarshii Yuuroo miiliyoona 35 hanga 40 ta'uun akka ta'e gabaafameera. Atletico Madrid taphataa kana kan itti fayyadame, Antoine Griezmann erga kilabii kana gadhiisee booda bakka isaa buusuufi qindoomina taphaatiif gargaarsa akka ta'uufi.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 14
english: The fourteenth day of the conflict between the United States and Iran has arrived, marked by the first pause in American airstrikes following nearly two weeks of continuous bombing. Despite this brief halt in military activity, the situation in the Strait of Hormuz continues to be volatile. It remains unclear if diplomatic discussions are making any progress toward resolving the ongoing tension.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት በ14ኛው ቀኑ ላይ ይገኛል፤ ይህም ያለፉትን 13 ቀናት ያለማቋረጥ ሲካሄድ የነበረው የአሜሪካ የአየር ድብደባ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ መቆሙን ያሳያል። ምንም እንኳን ወታደራዊ ጥቃቱ ለአፍታ ቢገታም፣ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ከፍተኛ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው የዲፕሎማሲ ውይይት ምን ደረጃ ላይ እንደሚገኝ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru guyyaa 14ffaa isaa irra ga’eera; kunis duula qilleensa irraa torban lama guutuu itti fufiinsaan gaggeeffamaa ture booda guyyaa jalqabaa dhaabate dha. Sochii waraanaa kana keessatti tasgabbii yoo jiraateyyuu, naannoo Hormuzitti waraansa cimaatu jira. Mariin dippilomaasii furmaata argamsiisuuf taasifamaa jiru maali irra akka ga’e ifatti hin beekamu.

title: F1 needs better balance between business and sport, says Norris
english: McLaren driver Lando Norris has criticized Formula One for prioritizing financial gain and business growth over the quality of the sport. He argues that recent technical regulation changes were driven by the desire to attract new manufacturers rather than to enhance racing performance. Norris also expressed concern that modern fans are increasingly focused on individual drivers rather than the sport itself, suggesting that the organizers need to refocus on the racing experience.
amharic: የማክላረን ተሽከርካሪ አሽከርካሪ ላንዶ ኖሪስ ፎርሙላ ዋን በስፖርታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ከማተኮር ይልቅ ለገንዘብ እና ለንግድ ትርፍ ቅድሚያ እየሰጠ መሆኑን ተችቷል። በቅርቡ የተደረጉት የቴክኒክ ህግ ለውጦች የተከናወኑት የስፖርቱን ጥራት ለማሻሻል ሳይሆን አዳዲስ ኩባንያዎችን ለመሳብ በማሰብ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም አዲሶቹ ደጋፊዎች ለስፖርቱ አጠቃላይ ሂደት ከመጨነቅ ይልቅ በአሽከርካሪዎች ስብዕና ላይ ብቻ ማተኮራቸው ስፖርቱን እየጎዳው መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Abbaan konkolaataa McLaren Lando Norris, Formula One ispoorticha irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa bu'aa qabeessummaa fi daldalaaf dursaa kennuun isaa sirrii miti jechuun ceephera. Jijjiiramootni seeraa yeroo dhihoo as godhaman kanneen, qulqullina qophiichaa fooyyessuuf osoo hin taane, warshaalee haaraa harkisuuf jedhamee kan murtaa'an ta'uu ibseera. Akkasumas, hordoftootni ammaa ispoorticha waliigala isaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa, namoota dhuunfaa qofa hordofuun isaanii akka ispoortichi miidhamu godheera jechuun yaada isaa ibseera.

title: What’s behind the ICC investigation into Karim Khan?
english: The International Criminal Court's chief prosecutor, Karim Khan, has been removed from his position following allegations of sexual misconduct. His legal team claims these accusations are politically motivated and intended to discredit him for pursuing war crimes charges against Israeli officials. The investigation into his conduct has raised significant questions regarding the pressures facing the court's leadership.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ካሪም ካን በፆታዊ ትንኮሳ ክስ ከስልጣናቸው ተነስተዋል። የሕግ አማካሪዎቻቸው እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ክሶች በእስራኤል መሪዎች ላይ የጦር ወንጀል ክስ በመመስረታቸው የተነሳ የተፈጠረ የፖለቲካ ሴራ ነው። የካሪም ካን ከስልጣን መነሳት በዓለም አቀፉ ፍርድ ቤት አመራር ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጫና ጥያቄ ውስጥ አስገብቷል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa olaanaa mana maree yakka addunyaa (ICC) Karim Khan, himata gudeeddii fi miidhaa walqunnamtii saalaa dhiyaateef hordofee hojii isaa irraa kaafameera. Gareen abukaattoota isaa akka jedhanitti, himannaan kun kan dhiyaateef hogganoota Israa'el irratti himata yakka waraanaa dhiyeessuu isaatiin walqabatee haaloo bahuuf kan qindaa'e dha. Buqqa'uun Karim Khan dhiibbaa mana murtichaa irra jiru irratti gaaffii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Iran blames US for Hormuz dispute as both sides confirm ongoing talks
english: Iran has accused the United States of violating their peace agreement by attempting to establish new transit routes through the Strait of Hormuz without consultation. Despite this tension, both countries have halted direct military strikes for the first time in two weeks, signaling a potential move toward de-escalation. While diplomatic channels are open and discussions are ongoing, significant mistrust remains, leaving the status of their interim deal uncertain.
amharic: ኢራን አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል ያለ ምክክር አዲስ የመተላለፊያ መስመሮችን ለመክፈት በመሞከር የሰላም ስምምነታቸውን ጥሳለች ስትል ከሳለች። ይህ ውዝግብ ቢኖርም፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለሁለት ሳምንታት ሲካሄድ የነበረው ጥቃት መቆሙ የውጥረት መቀነስ ምልክት ታይቷል። ምንም እንኳን የሁለቱ ወገኖች የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ተጀምሮ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ ከፍተኛ አለመተማመን ስላለ ስምምነቱ አሁንም እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Iraan, Amerikaan karaa Hormuz keessatti marii tokko malee daandii haaraa banuuf yaaluun walii galtee nagaa isaanii akka cabsite himatteetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun jiraatus, biyyoonni lameen torban lamaaf wal-itti fufiinsaan raawwatamaa ture dhaabuun isaanii rakkoon sun akka hir'achaa jiru mul'isa. Karaan diippiloomaasii banamee mariin kan itti fufe ta'us, amanamummaan waan jiruuf walii galtichi yerootiif qofa ta'uu isaa dubbatameera.

title: Baby rescued after Israeli settlers set home on fire amid raids
english: A baby was saved by family members after Israeli settlers intentionally ignited a fire at their home in the occupied West Bank. This attack occurred during a wave of intensified raids by settlers and military forces in the Nablus area. These incidents follow a fatal shooting that took place on Friday, leading to heightened tensions in the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በአንድ ቤት ላይ ሆን ብለው እሳት በመልቀቃቸው ህፃን ልጅ በቤተሰቦቿ ታድጋለች። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በናብሉስ አካባቢ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች እየተካሄደ ባለው ተከታታይ ወረራ ወቅት ነው። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ከአርብ ዕለት ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ በኋላ በተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo waldhabiinsaan guutame kan West Bank keessatti, manni jireenyaa tokko qonnaan bultoota Israa'elii qabsiifamuu isaatiin, daa'imni tokko maatii isheetiin oolchamee jira. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo waraannii Israa'elii fi qonnaan bultoonni magaalaa Naablus keessatti duula bal'aa gaggeessaa jiranitti. Gochi kunis, gaafa Jimaataa dhukaasa du'aan xumurame booda sababa walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu isaatiin kan dhalate dha.

title: Iraqi air defences down drone near US consulate in Erbil
english: Iraqi military forces successfully intercepted and destroyed an unmanned aerial vehicle flying close to the American consulate in Erbil. Security officials confirmed that the incident took place on Saturday within the Kurdistan region. No further details regarding the drone's origin or potential motives were provided at this time.
amharic: የኢራቅ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኢርቢል ከተማ ከሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ቆንስላ አቅራቢያ የሚበር ድሮን ተኩሰው መትተው ጥለዋል። የፀጥታ ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኩርዲስታን ክልል ነው። ስለ ድሮኑ መነሻ ወይም ዓላማ የተገለጸ ተጨማሪ መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Humnootiin nageenyaa Iraaq magaalaa Erbiil keessatti konsulaata Ameerikaa biratti xiyyara nama hin feene (drone) tokko rukutanii kuffisaniiru. Maddoonni nageenyaa akka ibsanitti, gochi kun kan raawwatame Dilbata darbe naannoo Kurdiistaan keessatti dha. Hanga ammaatti waa'ee xiyyarichaa fi kaayyoo isaa irratti odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: After ‘testing ground’ in Kashmir, pellet guns used on student protesters in India's capital
english: Indian security forces are facing allegations of using dangerous pellet guns against student protesters and journalists in New Delhi. While police initially denied these claims, the Rapid Action Force later acknowledged that excessive force had been used during the demonstrations for educational reform. These protests, which led to the resignation of the education minister, began after officials insulted unemployed youth and corruption scandals surfaced regarding medical entrance exams.
amharic: የህንድ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኒው ዴልሂ በተማሪዎች እና በጋዜጠኞች ላይ አደገኛ የሆኑ የብረት ጥይቶችን (pellet guns) ተጠቅመዋል የሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ፖሊስ መጀመሪያ ላይ ይህን ቢክድም፣ የፈጣን ምላሽ ሰጪ ኃይል (RAF) በስልጠና እና በትምህርት ማሻሻያ ጥያቄዎች ላይ ተቃውሞ ሲያደርጉ የነበሩ ሰዎችን በመበተን ረገድ ከመጠን ያለፈ ኃይል መጠቀሙን አምኗል። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች የተጀመሩት በመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ንቀት እና የትምህርት ፈተና ሙስና ቅሌት ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ በመጨረሻም የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ አስገድዷል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Hindii, Niiw Deelhiitti barattootaa fi gaazexeessitoota irratti miilaa (pellet guns) fayyadaman jedhamanii himatamaa jiru. Poolisiin jalqaba himannaa kana haaluus, humnoonni ittisaa (RAF) sochii barattootaa irratti humna garmalee fayyadamuu isaanii erga qorannoo booda hubataniiru. Tariiwwan kun kan jalqaban jechoota qeeqaa fi malaammaltummaa qormaata barnootaa irratti mufachuudhaan yoo ta'u, dhumarratti ministirri barnootaa aangoo gadi akka lakkisan taasisaniiru.

title: Iran's IRGC says four vessels stopped in Hormuz in last 24 hours
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently obstructed four ships in the Strait of Hormuz by firing warning shots. Officials stated the vessels were blocked for attempting to use a path labeled as an unsafe route. The military group has cautioned that any future ships found in restricted areas will encounter a firm and aggressive reaction.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይሎች በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አራት መርከቦችን አስጠንቅቀው ማቆማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። መርከቦቹ የገቡት አደገኛ ተብሎ በተፈረጀ መስመር በመሆኑ የባህር ኃይሉ የማስጠንቀቂያ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። ድርጅቱ ወደፊትም በዚህ በተከለከለ መንገድ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Waraana Iran (IRGC) dooniiwwan afur daandii galaana Hormuz irraa dhorkamuusaanii beeksisaniiru. Dooniiwwan kunneen karaa nageenya hin qabne jedhamee ramadame keessa waan darbuuf yaalaniif, humnoonni kun dhukaasa akeekkachiisaa bananiiru. Gareen kun gara fuulduraatti dooniiwwan daandii dhoorkame kana keessa darbuuf yaalan kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Israel kills head of northern Gaza police force
english: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza City has resulted in the death of Brigadier-General Abdel-Nasser al-Maqadma, who served as the northern Gaza police chief. Additional reports indicate that other personnel, including a medic and a previously wounded officer, have also died in recent violence. Israel has frequently targeted members of the Gaza police force, asserting that these individuals are affiliated with Hamas.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የሰሜን ጋዛ የፖሊስ አዛዥ የሆኑት ብርጋዴር ጄኔራል አብደል-ናስር አል-መቃድማ መገደላቸው ተሰምቷል። በተጨማሪም በሌሎች ጥቃቶች አንድ የህክምና ባለሙያ እና ቀደም ብሎ ጉዳት ደርሶበት የነበረ አንድ የፖሊስ አባል ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እስራኤል የጋዛ ፖሊስ አባላት ከሀማስ ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል በተደጋጋሚ ኢላማ እያደረገች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa raawwateen ajajaan poolisii kaaba Gaaza, Biriigader Jeneraal Abdeel-Naasir al-Maqadmaan ajjeefamaniiru. Kana malees, haleellaa biraatiin gargaaraan fayyaa tokkoo fi poolisiin duraan miidhamee ture tokko lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Israa'el miseensonni poolisii Gaaza miseensa Haamaas akka ta'an ibsuun, yeroo baay'ee qaamoolee kana irratti haleellaa raawwatti.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi oil sites
english: Houthi fighters launched drone and missile strikes against two Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Jizan and Yanbu to retaliate against Saudi-led air raids in Yemen. The group also threatened to continue obstructing shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, which has become a key route for Saudi oil exports. Meanwhile, subsequent Saudi air strikes in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf regions reportedly killed several Houthi fighters and technical experts.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ላይ ለሚፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች አጸፋ ለመስጠት በሳውዲ አረቢያ የጂዛን እና የያንቡ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ በድሮን እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ቡድኑ የሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመር የሆነውን የባብ ኤል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ መዝጋቱን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። በምላሹም የሳውዲ ጥምረት በየመን በወሰደው የአየር ጥቃት በርካታ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች እና የቴክኒክ ባለሙያዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin haleellaa qilleensa irraa irratti gaggeeffamuuf deebii kennuuf jecha, buufataaleen boba'aa Aramco kan Saudi Arabaa jiran lama, kanneen Jizan fi Yanbu jedhaman irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) fi misayiliin raawwateera. Gareen kun daandii galaana Bab el-Mandeb kan Saudi-in boba'aa ittiin ergitu cufuusaa akka itti fufu akeekkachiiseera. Gamtaan Saudi ammoo buufataalee Hutiin to'atu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa gaggeesseen miseensota Hutiifi ogeeyyota teeknikaa hedduu ajjeeseera.

title: Two buses collide in Syria, killing at least 35 people
english: A serious traffic accident occurred in central Syria when two passenger buses collided on the highway connecting Damascus and Deir ez-Zor. This tragic event resulted in at least 35 fatalities and left numerous others injured. Emergency responders have deployed helicopters to transport the survivors to a nearby military hospital for urgent medical care.
amharic: በሶሪያ መካከለኛው ክፍል በደማስቆ እና በዴር ኤዞር አውራ ጎዳና ላይ ሁለት አውቶቡሶች ተጋጭተው ከባድ አደጋ ደረሰ። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢያንስ 35 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች በአቅራቢያ ወደሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ሆስፒታል ለማጓጓዝ ሄሊኮፕተሮችን አሰማርተዋል።
oromo: Siriyaa giddu galeessatti konkonkalaa imaltootaa lama karaa gurguddaa Daamaasqoo fi Deeyr Ez-Zoor wal quunnisiisu irratti walitti bu'aniin balaan ulfaataan mudateera. Balaa gaddisiisaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 35 ol darbeera, namoonni hedduunis miidhaniiru. Gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kennuufis xiyyaarota helikopterii fayyadamuun miidhamtoota gara hospitaala waraanaatti geeffachaa jiru.

title: India’s youth protesters are fighting Modi with irreverent humour and memes
english: Young protesters in India are using humor, memes, and viral social media content to challenge Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration. By creatively mocking police actions and pro-government media, they are effectively shifting the public narrative and gaining wider support for their demands for educational reforms. This digital strategy has turned tense confrontations into relatable online content, helping activists cope while keeping pressure on a government sensitive to its public image.
amharic: በህንድ የሚገኙ ወጣት ተቃዋሚዎች የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲን አስተዳደር ለመቃወም ቀልዶችን፣ ሜሞችን እና የተለያዩ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ይዘቶችን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ከፖሊስ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን ግጭት እና የመንግስት ደጋፊ ሚዲያዎችን በመቀለድ ህዝባዊ ትረካውን ወደራሳቸው በመቀየር የትምህርት ማሻሻያ ጥያቄያቸውን በስፋት እንዲስተጋባ እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ዲጂታል ስልት ተቃዋሚዎቹ ለራሳቸው መጽናኛ ከመሆናቸውም በላይ በመንግስት ላይ ያለውን ጫና እንዲጨምር አድርጓል።
oromo: dargaggoonni Hindii mootummaa muummicha ministeeraa Narendra Moodii mormuuf jecha kolfiisaa, meemii fi qabiyyee miidiyaalee hawaasummaa fayyadamaa jiru. Gamtaan kun walitti bu’iinsa poolisii fi gabaasa miidiyaa mootummaa deggaran irratti qoosuun yaada uummataa jijjiiruufi gaaffii jijjiirama barnootaa isaanii bal’inaan dhageessisuuf gargaareera. Dhiibbaan dijitaalaa kun mormitoonni akkaataa itti dhiphina keessatti of tasgabbessan ta’uun, mootummaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
english: President Trump attended the White House Correspondents' Dinner, an event held to celebrate press freedom following a shooting incident earlier this year. While he praised the resilience of the press and honored a Secret Service officer, he also used his speech to criticize journalists and political opponents. Despite the mixed tone of his remarks, the president emphasized the importance of settling disagreements through open debate rather than violence.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ አደጋ ምክንያት ከተቋረጠ በኋላ ነፃነትን ለማክበር በተዘጋጀው የጋዜጠኞች ማህበር እራት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የጋዜጠኞችን ጥረት ቢያደንቁም በንግግራቸው ወቅት መገናኛ ብዙኃንን እና የፖለቲካ ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተችተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ንግግራቸው ቅይጥ ስሜት ቢኖረውም፣ አለመግባባቶችን በጠመንጃ ሳይሆን በውይይት መፍታት እንደሚገባ አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp sirna soorata galgalaa kan gamtaa gaazixeessitoota Waayit Hawusirratti argamuun bilisummaa miidiyaa kabajuu ibsaniiru. Gochaan kun kan qophaa'e erga kanaan dura miidhaan dhukaasaa mudatee booda dha. Pirezidaantiin kun gaazixeessitoota kan galateeffatan ta'us, haasaa isaanii keessatti miidiyaaleefi mormitoota siyaasaa isaanii qeeqaniiru. Haasaa isaanii keessatti, wal-dhabiinsa kamiyyuu dhukaasaan osoo hin taane mariin furuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru.

title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
english: The Houthi group, which receives support from Iran, has launched a missile attack against Saudi Arabia following recent Saudi airstrikes on Yemen. This retaliation caused fires in the Saudi city of Jizan, leading to emergency alerts in the region. Meanwhile, broader tensions remain high as the U.S. continues its naval blockade and ongoing military posturing in the Middle East.
amharic: ኢራን የምትደግፋቸው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የቦምብ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ይዞታዎች ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ካደረሰች በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በጂዛን ከተማ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። በአካባቢው ያለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ አሁንም የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን የንግድ እገዳ እና ወታደራዊ ዝግጅቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: gareen Hutiin jedhamu kan Iran deeggaramu, haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan dura Sa'udii Arabaa irratti raawwatamee ture hordofee haleellaa mishaayilii irratti raawwachuu isaa ibseera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame Sa'udiin buufataalee Hutiin Yemen keessatti qabu erga rukuttee booda yoo ta'u, magaala Jizaaniin keessatti ibidda kaaseera. Walitti buutiin naannichaa kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, Ameerikaanis dhiibbaa diinagdee fi qophii waraanaa gara Iranitti taasiftu itti fuftee jirti.

title: How Volker Turk won a new term as UN rights chief despite Israel opposition
english: Volker Turk has been re-elected as the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights for a second four-year term. Despite facing significant opposition from the United States, Russia, and Israel due to his vocal criticism of their policies, he received overwhelming support from the General Assembly. Turk, who has led the office since 2022, becomes the first individual to serve two consecutive terms in this role.
amharic: ቮልከር ቱርክ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር ሆነው በድጋሚ ተመረጡ። በአሜሪካ፣ በሩሲያ እና በእስራኤል በኩል ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ባደረገው ድምፅ አብላጫ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። ከ2022 ጀምሮ በኃላፊነት ላይ ያሉት ቱርክ፣ ይህንን ቦታ ለሁለት ተከታታይ ጊዜያት የመሩ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሆነዋል።
oromo: Volker Turk yeroo lammaffaaf itti gaafatamaa mirga namoomaa kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii ta'anii filatamaniiru. Yaa'iin waliigalaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii sagalee guddaadhaan deeggarsa isaa erga kenneefii booda, Turk waggoota afur ittaantuuf iddoo kana kan hogganan ta'a. Mootummoonni Ameerikaa, Raashiyaa fi Israa'el siyaasa isaanii irratti komii inni qabu mormus, Turk aangoo isaa itti fufuuf carraa argateera.
